jobs.title: AI Builder — Agents & Automation
jobs.description: Full\-time · Northwest Arkansas $60,000–$85,000 annually, depending on experience and proven builds, plus benefits Help build an AI\-first business. We’re looking for a hands\-on AI builder to join our energetic, fast\-paced team. You’ll create agents, connect tools and turn complex work into efficient, repeatable processes across our brands, manufacturing operation and back\-office systems. If you’ve spent thousands of hours building custom agents, reusable skills and tools—and you’re already using AI to improve how you work, live or run a business—keep reading. We’re an innovative startup built by proven entrepreneurs who like to make stuff. You’ll work directly with the founders to advance systems they’ve started, develop new capabilities and carry your work through testing, debugging and continued improvement. You’ll have meaningful problems to solve, room to experiment and plenty of “what if we tried this?” conversations—with people who move quickly and follow through. Bring deep AI experience, a collaborative attitude and an appetite for learning new technology. What you’ll do * Finish and improve existing systems. Turn promising tools and prototypes into dependable workflows. * Find better ways to work. Identify opportunities to eliminate repetitive tasks, remove bottlenecks and increase capacity. * Build agents and reusable skills. Create specialized agents, coordinate their work and give them the context and tools to deliver useful results. * Connect the operation. Improve how information moves between orders, artwork, materials, production, shipping and office systems. * Own what you build. Test, debug, document, maintain and improve your solutions—and help the team use them. * Put new capabilities to work. Evaluate emerging AI tools and apply them where they make a measurable difference. What you bring * Substantial hands\-on experience building AI tools, custom agents, reusable skills and automated workflows. * Working examples you can demonstrate, including what failed and how you fixed it. * Hands\-on fluency with agentic development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or comparable tools—with working examples of agents, reusable skills and automations you’ve built, tested and improved. * Experience with AI coding tools, multi\-agent orchestration, hooks, context engineering, APIs, webhooks and MCP. * The judgment to understand our existing systems before adding new ones. * The ability to take business direction, work independently and follow through. * A collaborative approach, positive attitude and genuine curiosity about learning new technology—especially as AI evolves. Your experience may come from employment, your own business, school or substantial independent projects. Depth of experience and proven results matter more than a particular degree or job title. What success looks like Your work reduces manual effort, makes processes repeatable and helps a lean team grow without adding a separate person for every recurring task. Our goal is to reduce the founders’ hands\-on building and workflow\-management workload by 50%. We’ll establish a baseline, agree on priorities and measure progress through time saved, fewer corrections and tools the team relies on. Show us your work Tell us your AI stack: which tools and models you use, what you use each for, and what you can build independently. Describe your level of expertise with each and where you’re still developing your skills. Share two projects that demonstrate your ability. Explain the problem, the tools you chose, your contribution, how you tested the result and what you improved. We’d also like to hear what you’re ready to build next. A paid practical exercise may be part of the hiring process. Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $85,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Equipment Technician / Mechanic (Aerial Lifts) (Entry Level / Level 1)
jobs.description: Most mechanical jobs keep you in one lane. You do engines, or you do hydraulics, or you do electrical work. On an aerial lift, you work all of them on the same machine, sometimes in the same afternoon. A boom that won't extend might be a hydraulic valve. It might be a sensor, a corroded connector, or a safety interlock doing exactly what it was designed to do. Figuring out which one is the job, and it is a lot more interesting than swapping parts until the problem goes away. We are looking for someone with mechanical ability who wants to learn that kind of troubleshooting from the ground up. You do not need aerial lift experience. We will teach you. **Who we are** Socage North America is the U.S. branch of Socage, an Italian manufacturer of truck\-mounted aerial lifts (bucket trucks) and tracked spider lifts. Our Epping, New Hampshire shop handles pre\-delivery inspections, service, and parts for Socage equipment in the U.S. We are a small team, which means you will work directly alongside senior technicians and leadership, not get lost in a big service department. We’re growing fast and this is a chance to get in early. **What you'll work on** Two kinds of machines, with very different personalities: * **Truck\-mounted aerial lifts.** Booms built on commercial truck chassis, powered through a PTO. These beasts range from 30’ to 300’ in height. You'll learn the truck side and the lift side. * **Tracked spider lifts.** Compact, self\-propelled lifts on tracks that set up on outriggers for work in places a truck can't reach. Hydraulics, electronics, computer controls, and some interesting mechanics, all in one package. **Day to day, you will:** * Perform pre\-delivery inspections on new and used machines and get them ready for customers * Handle scheduled maintenance: fluids, filters, lubrication, hose inspection, batteries, tracks and tires, torque checks, and full function tests * Replace hoses, fittings, switches, lights, wear pads, and basic electrical components * Work next to senior techs on diagnostics and major component jobs * Check machines in and out with customers, including inspections, photos, and walking them through the work that was done * Receive, stock, and track incoming and outgoing parts used in service * Ride along on field calls and help transport equipment This is primarily a shop role. Field work and overnight travel are limited and always alongside an experienced technician. **How you'll learn** You will be paired with a senior technician as your mentor and follow a written development plan with a skills checklist. Along the way, we provide: * Hands\-on training on Socage bucket trucks and spider lifts, plus factory product training * Instruction in reading hydraulic and electrical schematics, service manuals, and service bulletins * OSHA 10, MEWP operator training, and lockout/tagout training, provided by the company * Specialty and diagnostic tools, including diagnostic laptops **There is a defined path up.** After 6 \- 12 months, completion of the skills checklist, and a successful field evaluation, you become eligible for promotion to Aerial Lift Technician 2, a stand\-alone technician role. Technician 3 is the senior level after that. **You'll fit in here if you've worked as or trained in** * Heavy equipment, construction equipment, or forklift repair * Auto mechanics or diesel and truck repair * Agricultural, marine, or small engine repair * Industrial maintenance, or a technical school program in any of the above * Military vehicle or equipment maintenance (see below) If you have ever traced a wiring problem, rebuilt something hydraulic, or worked on PLCs, tell us about it. Students and apprentices in technical programs are welcome to apply. **Served in uniform? Your experience counts here.** If you maintained vehicles or equipment in the military, you already know much of this work: hydraulics, 24V electrical systems, diesel engines, schematics, and doing it safely by the book. We especially want to hear from people who served in roles such as: * **Army:** 91B Wheeled Vehicle Mechanic, 91L Construction Equipment Repairer, 91H Tracked Vehicle Repairer, 91E Allied Trades Specialist * **Marine Corps:** 1341 Engineer Equipment Mechanic, 3521 Automotive Maintenance Technician * **Navy:** Construction Mechanic (CM, Seabees), Aviation Support Equipment Technician (AS) * **Air Force:** 2T3X1 Vehicular Equipment Maintenance, 2A6X2 Aerospace Ground Equipment * **Coast Guard:** Machinery Technician (MK) Don't see your code? Apply anyway and tell us what you worked on. **What you need** * High school diploma or GED, or current enrollment in a technical or vocational program * At least 18 years old (required to operate aerial lifts and company vehicles) * Some hands\-on mechanical experience, from work, school, or the military * High aptitude for complex systems (mechanical, electrical, electronic) * Basic hand tools, or willingness to build a set (we provide the specialty tools) * Valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and the ability to stay insurable on our vehicle policy * DOT Medical Card, or the ability to get one within 15 days of hire * Ability to pass a pre\-employment drug screen and any required DOT drug and alcohol testing * Comfortable using a computer, phone, and camera for work orders and photos * Comfortable working at height in an aerial platform with fall protection * A safety\-first attitude and reliable attendance **Nice to have:** diesel, automotive, or heavy equipment coursework; exposure to hydraulics or 12V/24V electrical; ASE, OSHA 10, forklift, or MEWP certifications; experience with truck chassis or PTOs; basic welding or fabrication. Bi\-lingual in Spanish, Portuguese, or Italian is a plus. **The physical side** This is hands\-on work. You'll regularly lift more than 50 lbs., work under equipment and in tight spaces, climb onto truck bodies, turrets, and outriggers, and work outdoors in New England weather in every season. Proper PPE is provided and required. You will also need the eyesight to tell wire colors apart. **Pay and benefits** * Overtime paid at time and a half for hours over 40 in a workweek * Company sponsored Health/Dental/Vision plans eligible from day 1\. * Paid company holidays * 15 Days accrued Paid Time Off (starts accruing day 1\) * Paid training and certifications, and company\-provided specialty tools * A written path to promotion Pay: $27\.00 \- $29\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Geospatial Web Applications Developer (ADMINISTRATOR IV)
jobs.description: **Introduction** ---------------- The Maryland Department of Planning’s Geospatial Applications and Technology Unit is seeking an innovative professional for the role of Geospatial Application Developer. This position, which reports directly to the manager of the GDA Unit, will be responsible for creating, enhancing, and managing state\-of\-the\-art, web\-based GIS solutions and applications. This position offers an opportunity to contribute to Maryland Department of Planning’s mission by supporting statewide initiatives with modern, data\-driven solutions that advance operational efficiency, transparency, and accountability. **GRADE** --------- STD0019 **LOCATION OF POSITION** ------------------------ 120 E. Baltimore St., Baltimore, MD 21202 **Main Purpose of Job** ----------------------- The Geospatial Application Developer serves as a technical lead within the Geospatial Applications and Technology (GAT) unit. This position is responsible for the design, development, enhancement, and maintenance of interactive, state\-of\-the\-art, web\-based GIS solutions and applications, ensuring compliance with Maryland’s accessibility standards. The role performs advanced geospatial analyses within an enterprise\-level Microsoft SQL Server environment, upholding strong data governance practices and providing quality assurance for analytical outputs. Additionally, this role provides support for the 2030 Census. The Geospatial Application Developer supports the Department’s strategic goals and statewide initiatives through modern, data\-driven solutions. **POSITION DUTIES** ------------------- Serve as a technical lead to develop, deploy, and maintain interactive GIS web applications and dashboards using ArcGIS Enterprise, Portal, ArcGIS API for JavaScript, and related frameworks such as Power BI, Qlik etc., for high impact GIS projects. Utilize Python, SQL, and other programming languages to automate workflows and integrate advanced analytics into web solutions. Ensure responsive design and compliance with State and departmental accessibility standards for public\-facing platforms. Serves as a technical lead on conducting a range of spatial analyses using Python, SQL, along with ArcGIS Pro. Reviews and validates analytical methods, scripts, and outputs produced by junior staff or project teams. Embed analytical outputs into dynamic web tools, dashboards, and visualizations for stakeholders. Lead the development and implementation of spatial data policies, procedures, and metadata standards to ensure data quality, integrity, security, and lifecycle management within the enterprise GIS environment. Identify, evaluate, and lead the integration of new GIS tools, software, database architecture, and automation processes including advancements in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) to continuously improve operational efficiency. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including data dictionaries, and conduct training sessions to ensure staff compliance with established GIS operational standards and best practices. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** -------------------------- Education: Graduation from an accredited high school or possession of a high school equivalency certificate. Experience: Six years of administrative staff or professional work. Notes: 1\. Candidates may substitute 30 credit hours from an accredited college or university for each year up to four years of the required experience. 2\. Candidates may substitute the possession of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university and two years of experience in administrative staff or professional work for the required experience. 3\. Candidates may substitute the possession of a Master's degree from an accredited college or university for five years of the required experience. 4\. Candidates may substitute U.S. Armed Forces military service experience as a commissioned officer involving staff work related to the administration of rules, regulations, policy, procedures and processes, or overseeing or coordinating unit operations or functioning as a staff assistant to a higher ranking commissioned officer on a year\-for\-year basis for the required experience. **DESIRED OR PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** --------------------------------------- Deep familiarity with ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Pro, and REST APIs. Experience managing spatial databases such as Microsoft SQL Server Experience developing interactive web\-based GIS applications and dashboards, including tools and technologies utilized, intended audience (internal or public), and the resulting impact. Advanced programming skills using Python, SQL, JavaScript, Arcade, and other programming languages. Experience using Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) processes, specifically using tools like Feature Manipulation Engine (FME). Experience coordinating technical solutions across cross\-functional teams, government agencies, or local stakeholders; strong written and verbal communication skills; strong attention to detail. **LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS AND CERTIFICATIONS** ---------------------------------------------- Employees in this classification may be assigned duties which require the operation of a motor vehicle. Employees assigned such duties will be required to possess a motor vehicle operator's license valid in the State of Maryland. **SELECTION PROCESS** --------------------- Please make sure that you provide sufficient information on your application to show that you meet the qualifications for this recruitment. All information concerning your qualifications must be submitted by the closing date. We will not consider information submitted after this date. Successful candidates will be ranked as Best Qualified, Better Qualified, or Qualified and placed on the eligible (employment) list for at least one year. **EXAMINATION PROCESS** ----------------------- The assessment may consist of a rating of your education, training, and experience related to the requirements of the position. It is important that you provide complete and accurate information on your application. Please report all experience and education that is related to this position. **BENEFITS** ------------ **STATE OF MARYLAND BENEFITS** **FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS** ------------------------ Online applications are highly recommended. However, if you are unable to apply online, the paper application and supplemental questionnaire may be submitted to: Department of Budget and Management, Recruitment and Examination Division, 301 W. Preston St., Baltimore, MD 21201\. Paper application materials must be received in our office by the closing date for the recruitment. No postmarks will be accepted. For questions regarding this recruitment, please contact the DBM Recruitment and Examination Division at Application.Help@maryland.gov or 410\-767\-4850, MD TTY Relay Service 1\-800\-735\-2258\. We thank our Veterans for their service to our country. People with disabilities and bilingual candidates are encouraged to apply. As an equal opportunity employer, Maryland is committed to recruitment, retaining and promoting employees who are reflective of the State's diversity.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend/Infra [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== At Concurrence, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payers, and government agencies run their patient\-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre\-visit intake, care navigation, post\-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single\-purpose chatbots or scribes, Concurrence is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments, and not just one narrow use case. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you. **About this role** =================== As a Senior Backend/Infra Engineer at Amigo, you'll build the core services behind our agent platform. The systems you own handle millions of conversations a month, so concurrency, reliability, and clean design are the job itself, not an afterthought. You'll own services end to end, from design through production. **What you'll do** ================== * Designing high\-throughput services that handle concurrent conversations at scale * Owning a core platform service from design to production * Building systems that stay available and degrade gracefully when things fail * Handling sensitive healthcare data with the care it requires * Improving performance, observability, and operational health across services * Shaping architectural decisions as the platform grows * Think carefully and holistically about system design under time pressure. **What we're looking for** ========================== * You've built and operated production backend systems at scale and owned the outcome * You're strong with concurrency, distributed systems, and service design * You prefer simple, maintainable solutions to hard problems * You debug well across services, queues, and databases * You're low ego, direct, and hold yourself to a high bar * You can work on site in New York City or San Francisco **Nice to have** ================ * Experience in a regulated or high\-reliability domain (healthcare, finance, legal) * High\-throughput or low\-latency system design * Experience with production AI or ML systems **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $220K \- $260K

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Tools
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, a tools engineer builds the tools that turn what our robots record in the field into data our models learn from. Engineers use the same tools to match a change in a robot’s telemetry to the moment an error happened. What a robot should learn from a day of real work is still an open question: which moments are worth training on, and which labels hold up under review. Some of our best labels come from records captured on site while the robots work. Data quality is model quality here. You will own the tools that decide what goes into a training set, and what those tools reveal about the data shapes where our R\&D goes next. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own the viewer engineers use to play back a robot’s data and line up telemetry with errors. * Own dataset curation: the dataset API and the tools engineers use to find and group episodes and build training sets. * Build annotation tooling with the rest of the software team, and weigh what we build against what we buy. * Build the quality review process for annotated data. * Work with the ML team who train on this data, the engineers who debug the fleet with it, and the annotators who label it. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have built an internal tool that became the way a team works. * Have built visualization or analysis tools for large volumes of sensor and video data. * Have built dataset tooling or a data pipeline that ML engineers train from. * Have designed a labeling or review workflow that people use to annotate data at volume. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Our Mission** =============== Expand human ambition in the physical world. *Critical infrastructure is constrained by labor shortages, hazardous working conditions, and operational complexity. Watney builds and deploys autonomous robotic systems that increase the speed and capacity of buildout, starting with data centers.* **About the Role** ================== At Watney, infrastructure engineers keep a fleet of robots in the field connected and safe to change. The robots do production work at customer sites and stream real\-time video from their cameras. The same infrastructure carries that video and data to our ML team and the rest of engineering. Changing software on robots that are doing real work, over customer networks we do not control, is a problem the field has not settled: how a change reaches the fleet safely, and how video and data keep moving when a network fails. Our software engineers run this infrastructure today alongside the robot software. You will partner with them, own it full time, and decide what a safe release looks like. Every robot in the field depends on that answer. At Staff, you lead the infrastructure changes that cross teams. **What You’ll Do** ================== * Own networking, remote access, and the real\-time video pipelines for the fleet. * Own CI, observability, and alerting for the fleet and the services behind it. * Build the release gate and rollout process for the fleet, and own the bar a change must clear. * Decide where data lives, how it is kept, and what our infrastructure costs to run. * Lead infrastructure changes with the software engineers who run this infrastructure today, and across the ML and fleet operations teams who depend on it. **You May Be a Good Fit If You:** ================================= * Have led an infrastructure change across several teams, or founded the team that owns one. * Have owned production networking or edge traffic for a large system. * Have migrated a large system in stages, through breaking changes, without breaking its users. * Have owned observability and alerting for a production system. * Have built tooling that other engineers rely on every day. We’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team. At Watney Robotics, we welcome people of all backgrounds and identities, and we make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential. If you’re passionate about robotics but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply! **Curious to learn more?** ========================== Follow us here on**X**and**LinkedIn**

With expanding manufacturing operations and a growing portfolio of major infrastructure projects, we are seeking an experienced Director of Engineering to lead our engineering department and support the continued growth of our business. The successful candidate will oversee engineering personnel, structural design, calculations, drawing production, technical reviews, project assignments, and engineering delivery schedules. The Director will work closely with our manufacturing, construction, project management, and executive teams to ensure that engineering deliverables are accurate, practical, cost\-effective, and completed within agreed project timelines. Engineering Quality Control and Drawing Management * Establish and maintain comprehensive engineering quality assurance and drawing review procedures. * Ensure engineering submissions are accurate, complete, coordinated, and properly checked before being issued. * Oversee preparation and delivery of preliminary, 90%, 100%, and final engineering drawing packages. * Manage engineering revisions, customer comments, technical responses, and resubmissions. * Ensure that customer\-provided drawings, specifications, and project requirements are properly incorporated into engineering packages. * Develop standardized engineering details, calculation templates, and drawing procedures. * Identify opportunities to reduce d elor's degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering from an accredited institution. * Minimum 10 years of progressive structural engineering experience. * Minimum 5 years of engineering leadership, departmental management, or senior technical management experience. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license in at least one U.S. state. * Current Nevada PE license or eligibility to obtain Nevada licensure through comity. * Extensive experience in reinforced concrete, precast concrete, structural steel, foundations, and connection design. * Strong working knowledge of IBC, ASCE 7, ACI 318, AISC, and other applicable structural engineering standards. * Demonstrated experience managing engineering teams, design schedules, and multiple concurrent projects. * Strong technical knowledge of structural calculations, engineering drawings, and design review procedures. * Proficiency with structural analysis and design software. * Excellent organizational, communication, leadership, and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to work independently, establish priorities, and take ownership of departmental performance. Preferred Qualifications * Nevada\-licensed Professional Engineer. * Structural Engineer (SE) licensure where applicable. * Experience with electrical substations, utilities, data centers, BESS, or industrial infrastructure. * Extensive experience with precast concrete wall systems and structural connections. * Familiarity with blast\-resistant structures, protective systems, or specialized security infrastructure. * Experience with RAM Structural System, RISA\-3D, SAP2000, ETABS, or equivalent software. * Proficiency with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and related engineering software. * Experience developing standardized engineering systems and improving departmental productivity. * Experience managing external engineering consultants and transitioning engineering work to internal teams. * Understanding of precast concrete manufacturing, heavy lifting, transportation, and construction installation requirements. The ideal candidate will have a strong structural engineering background, extensive experience managing engineering teams, and the ability to establish effective systems and procedures within a growing organization. This individual must be comfortable taking responsibility for departmental performance, maintaining engineering quality, resolving complex technical challenges, and ensuring projects are delivered on time. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Abode Money** --------------------- Abode Money is the first financial manager for homeowners. We save homeowners money on property taxes, insurance, mortgage and more, every year. Our vision is to be the first to create an ongoing relationship with 80M\+ homeowners. Homeowners spend $2T\+ a year on their homes with almost no help. We're the first and only company that can lower property taxes in all 50 states, and there's no better way into the homeowner relationship than the bill everyone hates. Most consumer fintechs are building slightly better versions of products that already exist. We're using AI to turn work that has always been a service into software, and there has never been a better moment to do it. We've raised $25M from Permanent, Drive, Sequoia, Core VC and 81 Collection. **The Role** ------------ This is the most AI\-pilled role at Abode. You're just as much product and design as you are engineer, and you use AI in every part of the job to move faster than anyone thinks is possible. You'll build the first version of new products, features, and flows in days, push code every day, and work directly with the CEO and growth team to see the impact in the numbers. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Launch New Products Fast:** Build MVPs of new products, features, and flows in days, from insurance and mortgage to whatever we bet on next. * **Ship Every Day:** Push code daily and turn funnel ideas into production tests fast. * **Own Product and Design:** Decide what to build, design the flow, and make the UX calls yourself. * **Build with AI:** Use AI across the whole stack to move faster, and show the rest of the team how. * **Measure Everything:** Instrument what you build and use the data to decide what's next. **Who You Are** --------------- * In Austin or willing to relocate. We work in person 5 days a week. * 5\+ years shipping consumer\-facing product * Strong with React, TypeScript, and a modern backend * Use AI for nearly everything you build and are always testing new tools * Have product and design taste, and care how the product feels to the customer * Are a former founder or early\-stage engineer who owns outcomes **Our Values** -------------- We hire people who want to own their work outright. * **Take ownership.** You get more autonomy here than almost anywhere else. Own the outcome, make the calls, and see it through. * **Move fast.** Speed is our only advantage, so we ship first and refine after. Sometimes that means fixing things in the open, and we're fine with that. * **Dive deep.** Go to the source. Pull the data, read the county code, call the assessor. The details are where we win. * **Be intellectually curious.** Learn new domains fast and keep asking why. Now is the time to work smarter, and AI is how we do it. * **Go all in.** We work hard and put in long hours because the window in front of us won't stay open forever. We're looking for people who want to do the same. **Compensation** ---------------- $170,000 – $220,000 base, plus equity Compensation Range: $170K \- $220K

jobs.title: ML Compiler Engineer, Neuron Kernel Interface
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Machine Learning accelerators are at the forefront of AWS innovation. Trainium delivers best\-in\-class ML training performance with the most teraflops (TFLOPS) of compute power for ML in the cloud. This is all enabled by the AWS Neuron Software Development Kit (SDK), which includes an ML compiler, the Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) compiler, and a runtime that natively integrates into popular ML frameworks such as PyTorch and JAX. Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare\-metal language and compiler for directly programming AWS Trainium instances. You can use NKI to develop, optimize, and run new operators directly on hardware while making full use of available compute and memory resources. Explore NKI: * https://awsdocs\-neuron.readthedocs\-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/index.html AWS Neuron is used at scale by customers such as Epic Games, Snap, Airbnb, Autodesk, Amazon Alexa, and Amazon Rekognition, along with many others across a range of segments. Amazon's Annapurna Labs is responsible for building innovative silicon and software for AWS customers. We are at the forefront of innovation, combining cloud scale with the world's most talented engineers. Our team covers multiple disciplines including silicon engineering, hardware design and verification, software, and operations. With such breadth of talent, there is opportunity to learn all the time. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. When you couple that with the ability to work on so many different products and services, it makes for a unique learning culture. Learn more about our history: * https://www.amazon.science/how\-silicon\-innovation\-became\-the\-secret\-sauce\-behind\-awss\-success Explore the Product: * https://aws.amazon.com/machine\-learning/neuron/ As an ML Compiler Engineer with the Annapurna Neuron team, you develop and scale compilers to handle the world's largest ML workloads on AWS Trainium. You design and ship features across the compiler stack, work directly with Amazon ML partner teams to unblock their workloads, and grow your skills alongside senior engineers. You want to work close to the hardware, help bring new products and features to market, and ship high\-quality code. A background in Machine Learning, AI accelerators, or Kernel performance is helpful, but not required. In order to be considered for this role, candidates must be located near or willing to relocate to Seattle or Cupertino. Key job responsibilities * Design and build compiler features for the Neuron compilers. Your work may span the frontend, intermediate representations, optimization passes, and code generation for the hardware. * Own features from design through production: design, implement, test on hardware and simulation, and support customers. * Work with Amazon ML teams (PyTorch, JAX, and internal model teams) to understand their workloads and unblock them. * Give hardware teams compiler and programmability feedback on upcoming chips. * Review code and designs, and mentor newer engineers. A day in the life You start the day reviewing a teammate's code for a new compiler feature, leaving feedback before it merges. Mid\-morning, you work with a model team whose kernel isn't reaching peak performance on Trainium, and you trace the bottleneck through the compiler's passes. After lunch, you write and test the feature you designed last week, then run it on hardware to confirm correctness. The team moves quickly and you are always in the details. About the team We are the compiler teams behind AWS Neuron, the software that runs machine learning models on Amazon Trainium. Our ML compiler takes a full model from PyTorch or JAX and compiles the graph to run across the chip. The Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI) is a bare\-metal language and compiler that lets customers program Trainium directly, down to the compute and memory, for a new operator or a faster kernel. Together we own the path from framework model to silicon. Our mission is to make Trainium fast and fully programmable. Our teams are small and agile, and there is opportunity to learn all the time. We work closely with the hardware, runtime and framework teams, and with the Amazon ML teams who use our compilers.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------ * 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience * 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience * 1\+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience * 1\+ years of designing and developing large\-scale, multi\-tiered, multi\-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C\#, C\+\+, Java, or Perl experience * 1\+ years of Object Oriented Design experience * Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field * Experience programming with at least one software programming language **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ---------------------------- * 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience * Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Applications Engineer
jobs.description: Full\-time Hybrid (average of 2\-3 days in office per week) Mars Hill, NC $125,000 \- $160,000 \+ benefits About Us The Ammortal Chamber integrates five science\-backed modalities into one immersive 25\-minute session. Our clients include wellness clinics and spas, sports teams and athletic departments, hotels, and individuals who bring the Chamber into their homes. We are a small team with a startup culture. Hardware and software engineers, health professionals, and operators work side by side. Since shipping our first product we have grown steadily, and the software that drives the Chamber is now at the center of what comes next. This role offers hands\-on ownership, room to grow into technical leadership, and a direct hand in shaping how the Chamber works for the people who use it. What is this role and why does it exist? This role centers on Linux systems software for the Chamber: building and owning the application\-level software that runs on embedded Linux and interfaces with hardware over common serial and bus protocols — the software layer that sits above the firmware and drives the product. You'll occasionally reach up the stack into frontend work as well, giving you end\-to\-end understanding of the system. At the senior level, you are a technical owner in this layer. You help make the architectural calls, set the standard for code quality and testing, and serve as a go\-to person when a hardware\-software problem needs solving. You'll work closely with the hardware team, OT partners, and the rest of the software team, and you'll help level up teammates who are earlier in their careers. Responsibilities* Own the design and development of Chamber application software on embedded Linux, including hardware communication over serial and bus protocols * Lead architectural decisions for our microservices\-based platform and drive them through to implementation * Define and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, and deployment * Act as the technical escalation point for complex customer and field issues * Maintain and occasionally extend early\-gen Chamber software * Contribute to frontend work as needed to ship complete features * Collaborate with hardware, operations, and customer experience teammates to deliver end\-to\-end solutions Skills to Excel* **Systems Thinking:** Deep understanding of how software, operating system, and hardware interact, and where problems tend to hide * **Technical Judgment:** Makes sound architectural tradeoffs and can explain them clearly * **Ownership:** Takes responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks; follows problems through to resolution * **Attention to Detail:** Organized and methodical in development, testing, and debugging * **Continuous Learning:** Stays current and curious across languages, tools, and patterns * **Customer Focus:** Understands how technical decisions affect the people using the product * **Communication:** Works well across disciplines and translates between hardware, software, and business needs * **Comfortable Multitasking:** Manages multiple priorities and shifts context without losing the thread * **Team Collaboration:** Works effectively in a small, cross\-disciplinary team; enjoys helping others grow and gives clear, constructive feedback **Requirements** What technical knowledge do you need to perform in your role?**Required** * Strong proficiency in Go, C, or C\+\+, and at least one high\-level language (Python, JavaScript, or similar) * Hands\-on experience interfacing software with hardware over serial or bus protocols (for example Modbus, I2C, SPI, RS\-485, or similar) * Deep familiarity with Linux environments, the command line, and system\-level debugging * Experience designing and shipping production software in a microservice or distributed architecture * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices * Understanding of software development lifecycle and testing practices **Preferred** * Experience with MQTT or other IoT communication protocols * Experience with Docker and containerized deployments on embedded or edge hardware * Familiarity with Debian\-based Linux systems * Experience with Next.js, React, and TypeScript * Familiarity with shell scripting (Bash) * Familiarity with a project tracking tool (Asana, Linear, Jira, or similar) * Familiarity with AI\-collaboration tools and agents Qualifications**Must haves** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on Linux\-based systems **Nice to haves** * Previous experience in an embedded Linux, IoT, robotics, industrial automation, or connected hardware role * Previous experience with real\-time or safety\-conscious systems * Contributions to open\-source or personal projects demonstrating depth in systems software **Benefits** Pay, Location, Hours* Pay range: $125,000 \- $160,000 * Benefits: 80% health, dental, and vision covered. * Flexible paid time off. * Location: Hybrid in the Asheville, NC area. Onsite at least 2 days per week, can be more some weeks depending on current assignments. * Relocation assistance available if you do not currently live in the Greater Asheville area or within commuting distance to Mars Hill, NC.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the Role** ------------------ Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest\-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well\-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first\-party and third\-party compute. As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real\-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production\-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes\-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend. You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high\-autonomy, high\-ambiguity environment. **This is a pipeline role feeding four areas.** **Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:** * **Data platform** Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need. * **Planning** Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross\-team coordination on the other. * **Efficiency** Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on. Instrumenting utilization across training, inference, and eval systems, building benchmarking infrastructure, establishing per\-config baselines, and working directly with system\-owning teams to close the gaps. The metric has to be good enough that the team on the hook for it agrees with the number. * **Attribution and forecasting** Connecting what the fleet costs to what the business is doing with it. Reconciling CSP billing exports against vendor telemetry and internal systems with mismatched schemas, attributing spend to the workloads and teams that generate it, and turning inference demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan. Efficiency metrics have to survive contact with finance: stripped of pure demand and unit\-price effects, reproducible month over month, and legible to a CFO. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build the planning and allocation stack — the tools leadership uses to allocate capacity, teams use to plan against their allocations, and the scheduler enforces. Cross\-region and cross\-provider placement, guardrails, queueing, occupancy KPIs. * Drive the efficiency programs: stranding and rightsizing, unused capacity recovery, and job\-level utilization across training, inference, and eval. Establish per\-config baselines and work with system\-owning teams to close the gaps. Utilization improvements are worth enormous sums at our scale. * Own attribution and forecasting — reconcile billing across ten\-plus providers against telemetry and internal systems, attribute spend to the workloads that generate it, and turn demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan and supply pipeline. * Build the data platform underneath all of it: pipelines ingesting occupancy, utilization, and cost from a rapidly diversifying fleet into BigQuery, with real ownership of completeness, latency SLOs, and gap detection. Every new provider is a net\-new integration. * Operate Kubernetes\-native systems at scale — collection agents, workload labeling, and th ow the data gets consumed. * Storage efficiency, retention, and lifecycle program experience at exabyte scale. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $485,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description: The Apple Services Engineering (ASE) team is one of the most exciting examples of Apple’s long\-held passion for combining art and technology. We are the people who power the App Store, Apple TV, Apple Music, Apple Podcasts, and Apple Books. And we do it on a massive scale, meeting Apple’s high expectations with high performance to deliver a huge variety of entertainment in over 35 languages to more than 150 countries. Our engineers build secure, end\-to\-end solutions. We develop the custom software used to process all the creative work, the tools that providers use to deliver that media, all the server\-side systems, and the APIs for many Apple services. Thanks to Apple’s unique integration of hardware, software, and services, engineers here partner to get behind a single unified vision. That vision always includes a deep commitment to strengthening Apple’s privacy policy, one of Apple’s core values. An environment that encourages deep focus and creative partnership, giving you the space to solve hard problems individually and the opportunity to build with a team of brilliant and dedicated engineers. Opportunities for professional growth, including dedicated mentorship, technical guidance from industry\-leading experts, and the ability to expand your skills across different parts of the services stack. A commitment to your well\-being, with genuine support for a healthy and sustainable work\-life balance. **Preferred Qualifications** These qualifications are not required, but they would help you make an even bigger impact. Proficiency in designing and building cloud\-native, distributed systems, with experience in microservices, container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), and event\-driven patterns (e.g., Kafka). Experience with modern frontend development, including web frameworks (e.g., React, Vue, Svelte) or native application development for macOS/iOS using Swift. Curiosity for applying emerging technologies, like generative AI, to solve engineering challenges. Experience designing and building large\-scale data pipelines for batch or stream processing using frameworks like Apache Spark or Apache Flink. Experience with modern observability practices and tooling (e.g., Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus), with a talent for diagnosing and troubleshooting complex issues in large\-scale systems. **Minimum Qualifications** We believe that the most innovative teams are diverse and inclusive. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Your skills and passion will stand out\-and set you apart\-especially if your career has taken a non\-traditional path. Core Backend \& Systems Engineering Experience building and scaling high\-performance backend services and APIs (e.g., GraphQL, REST, gRPC). We primarily use JVM languages (Java, Scala, Kotlin) but value polyglot engineers with experience in Go, Python, or Swift. Experience designing and building large\-scale data pipelines for batch or stream processing using frameworks like Apache Spark or Apache Flink. Proficiency in designing and building cloud\-native, distributed systems, with experience in microservices, container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes), and event\-driven patterns (e.g., Kafka). Strong fundamentals in data systems, with experience using both relational and NoSQL databases. Software Craftsmanship \& Operations A commitment to building high\-quality software and owning it from start to finish, demonstrated through practices like thorough testing, effective CI/CD, and performance tuning. Experience with modern observability practices and tooling (e.g., Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus), with a talent for diagnosing and troubleshooting complex issues in large\-scale systems. A strong understanding of security fundamentals and a commitment to building secure, resilient software. Collaboration \& Product Mindset A passion for mentoring other engineers and fostering a team culture of collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. A passion for product excellence and for deeply understanding customer needs to build better solutions. Curiosity for applying emerging technologies, like generative AI, to solve engineering challenges. A track record of building and delivering exceptional software. This can come from a variety of places: a related technical degree, a non\-traditional educational path, or equivalent practical experience. We believe your work and passion speak for themselves. An understanding of security fundamentals and a commitment to building secure, resilient software. Strong fundamentals in data systems, with experience using both relational and NoSQL databases. **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $142,300 and $214,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS: Lead maintenance, load\-balancing, and lifecycle management for multi\-module double\-conversion static or rotary UPS systems, static transfer switches (STS), power distribution units (PDUs), and energy storage solutions (VRLA, Lithium\-ion, battery strings). Emergency Generation \& Fuel Systems: Direct operational readiness, monthly no\-load testing, scheduled dynamic/load\-bank testing, and preventative maintenance on multi\-megawatt standby generator systems, emergency fuel storage/filtration polishing systems, and automated paralleling switchgear. Power Quality \& Monitoring: Continuously monitor power quality, harmonics, power factor, and transient disturbances utilizing the Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) and SCADA platforms. 2\. Operational Procedures \& Risk Mitigation (MOP / SOP / EOP) Procedure Authoring \& Review: Author, review, and strictly enforce detailed Methods of Procedure (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs) for all planned maintenance, testing, switching operations, and contingency drills. Switching Operations: Oversee MV and LV complex switching sequences, bypass operations, and utility\-to\-generator transfer scenarios to prevent unintended power interruptions. Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Lead post\-event investigations and technical root cause analyses for any power anomalies, outages, or near\-misses, driving corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to completion. 3\. Electrical Safety \& Regulatory Compliance Safety Leadership: Champion the site Electrical Safety Program in full compliance with NFPA 70E, OSHA 1910 Subpart S, and NFPA 70 (NEC). Code \& Environmental Compliance: Maintain compliance with local, state, and federal codes, including NFPA 110 (Emergency and Standby Power Systems), EPA air quality permits, spill prevention (SPCC) for fuel oil storage, and local environmental reporting. 4\. Preventative Maintenance \& CMMS Administration Manage annual, semi\-annual, quarterly, and monthly preventive/predictive maintenance programs (PM/PdM) via the site Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS). Oversee advanced non\-destructive diagnostic programs: infrared (IR) thermography, breaker primary/secondary current injection testing, relay calibration, and battery internal resistance/impedance testing. Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) including Planned Maintenance and Reactive Work orders completion rates, and power utilization metrics. 5\. Vendor, Project \& Commissioning Management Manage specialized critical electrical service contractors (e.g., switchgear testing houses, UPS factory technicians, generator service providers, relay engineers). Participate in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and Integrated System Testing (IST) for new electrical installations. 6\. Emergency Response \& Incident Command Participate in the 24/7 technical on\-call rotation for critical infrastructure system alarms, critical failures, utility interruptions, and severe weather response. Familiarity with commissioning levels 1 through 5 (from factory test through Integrated Systems Testing). **Minimum Qualifications** Experience: Minimum of 7\-10\+ years of hands\-on experience in critical facilities operations (e.g., enterprise data centers, semiconductor fabrication plants, central utility plants, or healthcare critical power environments). Leadership: Minimum of 3\+ years leading technical teams, sub\-contractors, or acting as a lead facility engineer. Electrical Systems Mastery: Direct operational experience with Medium Voltage switchgear (4\.16 kV \- 15 kV\+), including relay coordination, breaker rack\-in/rack\-out, and substation operations. In\-depth technical knowledge of commercial/industrial UPS topologies (static and/or rotary), battery management systems, and automatic static transfer switches (STS). In\-depth expertise in standby diesel generators, automated paralleling switchgear logic, governor/voltage regulator controls, and ATS systems. Safety Certifications: Thorough, documented mastery of NFPA 70E (Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace); Qualified Electrical Worker (QEW) credentials. Master or Journeyman Electrician License, OR Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Facilities Engineering, or related technical field, OR Equivalent specialized military electrical power generation/distribution experience (e.g., Navy Nuclear / Power Distribution).

jobs.title: Sr. Staff / Distinguished Engineer
jobs.description: Imagine the web itself as your raw material \- every page, every image, every signal of what’s new and what matters, flowing in at a scale most engineers only read about in systems papers. At Apple, that scale is a daily reality. The data acquisition platform you’d help lead doesn’t just power search \- it’s the sensory layer underneath Siri, Spotlight, Apple Maps, and the foundation models driving Apple Intelligence. Every one of those products depends on a continuous, exabyte\-scale pipeline of fresh, high\-quality information pulled from the live web, stored, and made usable in near real time. As a Sr. Staff / Distinguished Engineer on this team, you won’t just build the pipes \- you’ll shape the intelligence that decides what flows through them. This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems and machine learning: the hard problem isn’t only moving exabytes of data, it’s deciding what’s worth acquiring, how to score and prioritize it, and how to continuously improve that judgment as the web and Apple’s models evolve. You’ll work across engineering, AI research, and product teams to turn crawl and storage infrastructure into a system that gets smarter over time \- one whose decisions directly shape the quality of the intelligence millions of people rely on through Apple’s products. If you’re energized by distributed systems at their most extreme scale, know how to bring ML into the decisions that govern what data gets captured and how it’s valued, and want your judgment to shape the strategic direction of Apple’s AI data foundation, we want to talk to you. **Description** This role owns technical strategy and execution for Apple’s web\-scale data acquisition platform \- the systems that crawl, store, and deliver exabytes of web content and images to power Siri, Spotlight, Apple Maps, and Apple’s foundation models. Responsibilities span the full lifecycle of acquired data: crawl strategy and prioritization, the ML\-driven decisions about what’s worth capturing and how to value it, and the scalable storage and compute architecture that makes all of it usable downstream. As a senior member of the technical staff, you will set direction on how Apple acquires data efficiently, broadly, and precisely at a scale that few infrastructure problems in the industry match. The hardest problems here live at the boundary between distributed systems and machine learning: designing storage and compute that let engineering teams move fast without being bottlenecked by data gravity, while applying ML to decide what to crawl, how to score quality and relevance, and how those decisions should evolve as the web and Apple’s models change. You’ll also shape how downstream teams consume what’s acquired, to maximize its value for search ranking and AI model training alike. Success in this role depends on working across organizational boundaries \- partnering with crawl infrastructure, search indexing, and AI/foundation model teams to align architecture and ML strategy with Apple’s broader AI direction. You’ll be expected to navigate ambiguous, large\-scale technical tradeoffs independently, and to act as a trusted technical voice to senior leadership on direction, risk, and resourcing for one of Apple’s most foundational data platforms. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience with web crawling, search indexing, or large\-scale content pipelines specifically Familiarity with how training data pipelines feed large language or foundation models History of mentoring senior engineers and influencing org\-level architecture decisions **Minimum Qualifications** 12\+ years building and operating distributed systems at large scale (petabyte/exabyte\-class storage, compute, or data pipelines) Demonstrated experience applying machine learning to data quality, ranking, relevance, or prioritization problems in production Track record of setting technical direction across multiple teams as a senior lead \- not just within a single team’s codebase Experience partnering with ML/AI research teams to translate model needs into infrastructure and data requirements B.S. in Computer Science, M.S./PhD Preferred **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $262,500 and $394,000, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

You’ll collaborate across departments to help craft wireless solutions that elevate the customer experience with Apple products and services. Our goal is to ensure nothing stands in the way of our customers’ connections with their devices. If you join us, you’ll help build world\-renowned wireless systems so seamless that they almost feel like magic. Join the "Wireless Technology and Eco\-system (WTE)” organization, be part of a world\-class team of engineers; working with cross functional teams to drive innovation and develop products used by millions worldwide. Apple’s Wireless Software Architecture team is seeking talented, highly motivated and self\-directed engineers to work across layers on cutting edge wireless technologies. The position involves developing core wireless technologies that solves everyday problems for customers using iPhone, iPad, Watch and other wireless product lines. **Description** We are searching for a highly motivated Software Developer who can work as a part of an extraordinary development team. In this position, you will have the opportunity to develop exciting features for Apple’s next generation products. You work will involve wireless software and protocol development around IEEE 802\.15\.4 and Thread Mesh technology development in the space of Home Automation. Your contributions will make a clear difference towards future Apple products. **Preferred Qualifications** 2\+ years of experience in developing network protocol stacks based on OSI model. Preferred programming skills are C, C\+\+, Objective C, Swift. Experience with multi thread programming and strong knowledge of Operating Systems desired. Experience with writing software involving user space, kernel space interaction desired. Non\-blocking, asynchronous interface coding experience. Comfortable at developing middle\-ware software in OS daemons and interaction with drivers. Home automation experience is a plus. Working knowledge of IOT protocols such as IEEE 802\.15\.4, Bluetooth, Zigbee, Z\-Wave, WiFi, LoRa or Thread Mesh is a plus. Working experience with Open source Software is a plus. Clear and concise communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross functional teams. Passion for product quality and attention to detail. Passionate and inquisitive, seeks to tackle problems in innovative ways. **Minimum Qualifications** Bachelors, Masters or Ph.D in Computer Science or Engineering or a related field, or equivalent experience **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. The base pay range for this role is between $129,300 and $194,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

Accelerate Your Career Whether your background is in engineering, military service, manufacturing, field service, electronics, maintenance, or technical operations, you'll have opportunities to continuously grow your technical expertise. Solve Real Problems This role is perfect for curious minds who enjoy diagnosing issues, working hands\-on, and finding solutions in high\-pressure environments. ### **We're Looking For People Who** * Love troubleshooting and problem\-solving * Enjoy working hands\-on with complex equipment * Have experience in engineering, electronics, mechanics, robotics, manufacturing, semiconductor, military, aerospace, or technical service environments * Communicate effectively with customers and internal teams * Thrive in fast\-paced, technology\-driven environments * Are excited by learning new technologies ### **Ideal Backgrounds** We welcome candidates from: * Semiconductor Equipment * Field Service Engineering * Military Electronics \& Nuclear Programs * Robotics \& Automation * Aerospace \& Defense * Manufacturing Engineering * Electrical Engineering * Mechanical Engineering * Mechatronics * Industrial Maintenance * Technical Support \& Service Operations ### **Why Applied Materials?** At Applied Materials, you'll join the company that helps make possible the world's most advanced chips and displays. Your work will directly support innovations transforming how the world connects, communicates, and creates. If you're looking for a career where technology, problem\-solving, and impact come together, we'd love to meet you. **Join us and help engineer the future.** **Minimum Qualifications:** * Completion of an Associate degree, military technical training, field service experience, or trade certification * 4\-7 years of work experience in semiconductor industry or other equipment support industry * Advanced mechanical aptitude with pneumatics, hydraulics, electronics, vacuum, and/or thermodynamics * Strong knowledge of hand tools and their appropriate usage, including digital multimeters * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint * Possession of a valid driver’s license and the ability to obtain a passport, if travel is required. * Able to meet all on\-site requirements, including safety, environmental guidelines, and COVID\-19 protocols **Physical Requirements:** This position often requires extensive walking, standing for extended periods of time, working in tight spaces, bending, squatting, twisting, kneeling, reaching, climbing stairs and ladders, working at height, lifting up to 35 lbs., the ability to distinguish between colors and working with electricity, the ability to work in an environment with noise that may be difficult for some individuals with sensitivity to noise, and the use of hand and power tools. Additionally, because this position generally involves working in a clean room, it requires the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment such as coveralls, hoods, booties, safety glasses, gloves, respirators, chemical aprons, and face shields. **Additional Information** **Time Type:** Full time **Employee Type:** Assignee / Regular **Travel:** **Relocation Eligible:** No The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members.
