jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Does the opportunity to devote your talents to a cause much greater than yourself excite you? Do you find joy in building technology that helps grow a better world. The Arbor Day Foundation is a place where you can do work that matters with people who care. As we say at the Foundation: life is short, love where you work. As one of the world's largest conservation organizations, the Arbor Day Foundation inspires people to plant, nurture, and celebrate trees. We help people understand and use trees as a solution to global issues (like air quality, water quality, climate change, deforestation, poverty, and hunger) that are critical to survival. Join the Arbor Day Foundation as **Software Engineer** on the Technology team to design, build, and support the applications, integrations, and platforms that power our mission. This role works across custom applications, web applications, services, databases, integrations, cloud technologies, and enterprise platforms to deliver secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable solutions. Software Engineers share common core responsibilities but may be assigned different primary applications, platforms, projects, or areas of expertise based on team and business needs. **Your Support System:** * You’ll report to Manager, Software Engineering * You’ll collaborate with business users, analysts, project managers, the business Intelligence team, fellow developers, and external partners to understand needs and deliver effective solutions. **How we work:** * Location: Lincoln, Nebraska * Schedule: In\-office Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday; optional remote work on Wednesday and Friday. **What you’ll do:** * Design, develop, and maintain applications, services, integrations, and APIs that support the Arbor Day Foundation's mission. * Partner with business and technology teams to translate requirements and ideas into scalable, reliable software solutions. * Build and support solutions using technologies such as C\#, .NET, SQL Server, Azure, JavaScript, and enterprise platforms. * Develop system integrations and data flows that securely connect Foundation applications and external partners. * Troubleshoot and enhance existing applications, improving performance, usability, security, and reliability. * Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support. * Contribute to code reviews, technical standards, documentation, and continuous improvement efforts. * Explore new technologies and recommend solutions that help the Foundation work more effectively and increase its impact. **What you'll bring:** * Passion for the Foundation’s mission, nature, environmental stewardship, and people * 3\+ years of experience of software development. * Proficiency in C\#, .NET, and SQL Server. * Enjoys solving complex problems and building scalable solutions. * Can translate business needs into reliable software and integrations. * Communicates effectively and collaborates well across teams. * Is eager to learn and grow within Microsoft technologies, Azure, Dynamics 365, and related platforms. **What success looks like:** * You consistently deliver meaningful, high\-quality work within two\-week sprints, while communicating early when priorities or blockers shift. * You take ownership of work from planning through development, testing, deployment, and follow\-up. * You translate business needs into well\-defined technical solutions that can be effectively planned and delivered. * You build solutions that are secure, reliable, scalable, and maintainable, not simply "done." * You collaborate closely with teammates and business partners throughout the sprint to solve problems and keep work moving. * You actively participate in sprint planning, estimation, demos, and retrospectives, helping the team continuously improve. * You balance delivering today's priorities with improving the systems, technical practices, and platforms that support the Foundation long term. **Love Where You Work: Your Benefits \& Perks** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well\-being. Highlights include: Health \& Insurance * Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage – Multiple plan options, including PPO and HDHP. * Company\-Paid Life Insurance – $15,000 basic coverage, plus voluntary options. * Short\- \& Long\-Term Disability – Fully covered by the company. * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Free, confidential counseling and resources for you and your family. * Supplemental Insurance Options – Accident, Critical Illness (includes infertility coverage), and Hospital Indemnity plans available for additional protection. Financial Wellness * 401(k) Retirement Plan – Immediate eligibility with company match up to 5%; full vesting after 5 years. * Flexible Spending Accounts \& Health Savings Account – Pre\-tax savings for healthcare and dependent care expenses. Time Off \& Leave * Paid Holidays – Eight paid holidays, one floating holiday, and an annual “Unplug Time” during the holidays. * Parental Leave – 12 weeks paid for birthing parents; 2 weeks paid for non\-birthing parents. Also including for adoptions. * Paid Time Off – Vacation, sick leave, volunteer time off Learning \& Growth * Professional Development – Access to LinkedIn Learning and tuition reimbursement. * Annual Learning Goal – Encouraged to spend 40\+ hours on development. Wellness \& Perks * HealthJoy App – Included with health plan for easy care navigation. * Wellness \& Recognition – Incentives, recognition gifts awarded for work anniversaries \& birthdays * Exclusive Discounts \& Free Admission – Tree Adventure, Arbor Lodge State Historical Park, golf and more. **How to apply** We’re excited you’re considering growing your career with us. After you apply, we aim to follow up within two weeks \- and you’ll hear from us either way. Our hiring process typically includes: * Recruiter conversation (phone) * Hiring manager interview (in\-person/virtual) * On\-site interview with team members and leadership You’ll be kept informed at every step. To begin, submit your application with a resume and responses to the application questions. Every application is reviewed by a real person \- we do not use AI to select applicants. **The Arbor Day Foundation is an equal opportunity employer** The Arbor Day Foundation is committed to equal employment opportunities. We will not discriminate against Team Members or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis \[“protected class”] including, but not limited to: veteran status, uniform servicemember status, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, national origin, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law. This role is also expected to provide technical input as required to Armstrong’s industry leading products and business. Key Responsibilities: Technical Customer Account Relationship Ownership * Control and assist in managing all OEM existing and new pump package programs by ensuring all Project \& Application Engineers are achieving all engineering and design work per standards and technical commitments to OEM customers. * Build technical relationships with assigned Customer \[technical team(s)] to facilitate engagement and awareness of their product strategy and development roadmap. * Interact with customers as required to interpret applications, specifications, and provide solutions by developing engineering standards for a given product * Ensure zero impact to the on\-time delivery of Customer commitments, from co\-development of new integrated products to operations execution. Work Across Teams * Provides technical assistance, information, support and guidance to customers and sales representatives * Provides input for proposal, data packages, and product. May be asked to review orders written by sales representatives for correct pricing and product selections * Provide support and training as needed in SolidWorks to Designers and others in the team in order to, create and modify parts and assemblies in 3D and to create and modify detail drawings in 2D * Support inside and outside sales with pricing of pump packages and components * Lead or collaborate with global engineering/MPS teams to deliver modular performance systems to MPS channels (OEM, hyperscale data centers,…) Execute to Process * Ensure business systems are properly set up and document control is followed providing clear information for order entry * Ensures proper process is followed for Engineering Action Requests, Engineering Change Orders, for support of OEM Configurator work, for initiatives driving cost/price reductions, and for various OEM product design opportunities * Lead designs of Customer solutions and the DFX process (Design review for manufacturability \& assembly, quality, sourcing, service, delivery and commissioning), with stakeholder teams. * Own the delivery of clean manufacturing BOMs, from CAD to the PLM and the ERP. * Manage data in the Armstrong ERP system which requires BOM and routing updates, modifications and item creation * Issue drawing packages for pump packages to the assembly team and provide support during the build process Other duties as assigned by Management. EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS: * Bachelors of Science/Engineering degree in mechanical engineering required * Minimum 8 years experience in integrated packaged systems design, piping design and development of customer solutions, preferably in the HVAC industry * Strong oral and written communication skills; Ability to think clearly and logically, analyze quantitatively, problem solve and define technical requirements; Is highly analytical and understands how to visualize and present complex data * Proven success in working on individual projects and also as a dynamic team member and contributor * Experience and ability to use SolidWorks 3D, Excel, Word, and Power Point * Previous experience in HVAC and Plumbing pump industry strongly preferred. Other pumping industry experience highly desirable. * Previous experience with mechanical skid package and/or hydronic design. * Travel required, estimate 10% to 20% * Some international travel (Canada, Mexico, Europe, Asia) may be required * Ability to communicate with individuals by phone, email and face\-to\-face * High\-Performance cultural fit with the U.S. team is an asset **Why Armstrong Fluid Technology?** By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid\-flow technology. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

Bring challenging ideas and we’ll support you with the latest tech, tools, and systems that you need to succeed. We pride ourselves on our ability to imagine and invent solutions to problems of the future. You’ll be essential in this forward\-thinking approach to development. Together with the team, you’ll build and maintain our platform to bring thousands of stories to millions of listeners and unleash the power of the human voice. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home. jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Perception
jobs.description: **Who we are** Aurora’s mission is to deliver the benefits of self\-driving technology safely, quickly, and broadly. The Aurora Driver will create a new era in mobility and logistics, one that will bring a safer, more efficient, and more accessible future to everyone. At Aurora, you will tackle massively complex problems alongside other passionate, intelligent individuals, growing as an expert while expanding your knowledge. For the latest news from Aurora, visit aurora.tech or follow us on LinkedIn. ### **What we are looking for** Aurora hires talented people with diverse backgrounds who are ready to help build a transportation ecosystem that will make our roads safer, get crucial goods where they need to go, and make mobility more efficient and accessible for all. We are seeking a Software Engineer and Machine Learning practitioner to join the Perception Tracker Team at Aurora. In this role, you will play a critical part in elevating the Aurora Driver’s perception performance and support the expansion of our driverless operational domain across key routes throughout the United States. Your work will be fundamental to scaling our mission, directly contributing to the delivery of self\-driving benefits safely, quickly, and broadly. ### **In this role you will** * Tackle end\-to\-end perception challenges, including tracking dynamic actors, recognizing actions and attributes, and developing deep semantic understanding of diverse traffic environments. * Research and develop state\-of\-the\-art machine learning models to enhance perception performance in challenging, real\-world scenarios, such as highway versus urban driving, long\-range multi\-sensor tracking, varying weather conditions, and degraded sensor conditions. * Collaborate cross\-functionally to iterate on the Perception system, translating insights from on\-road and simulated testing into robust, high\-quality, and well\-tested software solutions. * Drive the software development lifecycle from prototype to production, focusing on large\-scale data analysis and the deployment of performing, production\-ready solutions on the real\-time Aurora Driver platform. * Contribute to architectural strategy and team collaboration, ensuring our perception systems remain scalable, efficient, and at the forefront of autonomous driving technology. * Example projects that a candidate could potentially contribute to (list not exhaustive): + Design and implement state\-of\-the\-art object tracking algorithms. + Design algorithms to extract, leverage, and fuse complementary information from different sensors. + Design and implement state\-of\-the\-art ML systems for object tracking and object attribute classification leveraging expertise in recursive state estimation, Hidden Markov models, structured prediction, and sequential models. + Build and improve model pipelines for large\-scale and efficient model training. + Analyze failure modes and implementation/testing of solutions to address the surfaced issues ### **Required qualifications** * Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or Bachelor with 1\+ years of relevant industry experience in software engineering). * Proficient software engineering skills in C\+\+ and Python, with a focus on writing clean, scalable, and efficient production\-quality code. * Basic knowledge in one or more focus areas: deep learning, computer vision, recursive state estimation, structured prediction, numerical optimization, and others. * Basic knowledge about 3D object tracking algorithms. * Experience with PyTorch, Tensorflow, and/or other deep learning frameworks ### **Desirable qualifications** * Strong grasp of fundamentals: linear algebra, discrete and continuous optimization, supervised and unsupervised methods, generative and discriminative methods, and Hidden Markov Models. * Hands\-on experience with VLM, foundational or world models. * Hands\-on experience in CUDA or high\-performance GPU programming for accelerated computing. * Experience with deploying production\-grade CV/ML models within real\-time computing environments. * Demonstrated experience automating ML workflows and optimizing training pipelines for efficiency. * Contributions to open source project(s) * Publication record at top\-tier robotics/computer vision conferences/journals, or strong industry experience in relevant fields (robotics, computer vision, self\-driving technology) * Proven ability to thrive in highly collaborative, cross\-functional engineering environments. *For roles based in Pittsburgh, PA:* The salary range for this position is $126,000 \- $201,000 per year. Aurora’s pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, the successful candidate’s starting base pay will be determined based on factors including job\-related skills, experience, qualifications, relevant education or training, and market conditions. These ranges may be modified in the future. The successful candidate will also be eligible for an annual bonus, equity compensation, and benefits. **Working at Aurora** At Aurora, we bring together extraordinarily talented and experienced people united by the strength of our values. We operate with integrity, set outrageous goals, and build a culture where we win together — all without any jerks. We believe in\-person work increases collaboration, empathy, and our ability to lead effectively. As a result, Aurorans are expected to work from the office at least 3 days per week, with some roles requiring more frequent in\-office presence, up to 5 days per week, based on operational needs. Our Careers page provides insight into what it is like to work at Aurora, and you can find all the latest updates in our Newsroom. **Our commitment to safety** At the core of everything we do is our commitment to safety. Building best\-in\-class self\-driving technology will take time, and we believe that each employee at Aurora has a role in contributing to safety, every step of the way. Aurora expects commitment to our safety policies from every employee, and seeks candidates who take an active responsibility, can contribute to building an atmosphere of trust, and invest in the organization’s long\-term success by prioritizing working safely, no matter what. **Our commitment to inclusion** Aurora considers candidates without regard to their race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy status, parent or caregiver status, ancestry, political affiliation, veteran and/or military status, physical or mental disability, or any other status protected by federal or state law. Aurora considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at careersiteaccommodations@aurora.tech. *For California applicants, information collected and processed as part of your application and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Aurora’s California Employment Privacy Policy.*

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **Job Description – Software Engineering Manager** Reports To \- Director of Engineering **Summary** AxisCare is hiring a full\-time, fully remote Software Engineering Manager to build and lead high\-performing engineering teams and to help us reimagine how software teams work in the age of AI. You've been a software engineer, so you know what it takes to build software. But your true calling is creating the environment where engineers thrive, succeed, and grow. That job is changing fast. We're no longer coding everything by hand. We're building the systems that let us bring great ideas to life and solve real customer problems quicker than ever before. (Read more about how we think AI is changing product development.) There will always be a need for people who deeply understand our customers' most important problems, solve them with high\-quality software, and run that software reliably in production. That's the work that endures, and you'll be building and leading the teams that do it. We're looking for a manager who's already internalized this shift. Someone who pushes their team to use AI tools aggressively, but who also has the judgment to know when the AI is producing confident\-sounding garbage, and who's building that same judgment in their engineers. Someone who helps their team develop taste and discipline, not just speed. **What You'll Do** Own the day\-to\-day health of your teams. Help engineers develop great daily habits, strong communication, and reach the next level, including helping them grow from engineers who only write code into engineers who direct AI effectively. Partner with product and design counterparts to quickly get from "important customer problem" to "working software," favoring rapid iteration over upfront resolution of every ambiguity. Partner with staff engineers on technical direction, code design, and systems thinking. Set a high standard of excellence and lead by example, including in how you and your team adopt AI tools and rethink your workflows. If you're asking your engineers to embrace this shift, you'd better be living it yourself. Stay hands\-on by running spikes, prototyping, and exploring ideas your team hasn't had time to chase, without taking on critical\-path work. Coach engineers to use AI as a core part of how they build: when to trust the output, when to throw it out, and how to maintain code quality when the machine is doing the typing. Teach them to fish rather than doing it for them. Challenge your team's assumptions about how software gets made. Question old habits inherited from the era of scarce coding time (exhaustive PRDs, excessive backlog refinement, premature mockup fidelity, story\-point ceremony) and encourage cheaper, faster paths to working software. Create an environment where engineers think about the whole problem, not just the code: understanding customer needs, system dynamics, and what it takes to run software reliably in production. AI makes it dangerously easy to build the wrong thing quickly, so clear thinking about what to build matters more than ever. **What We're Looking For** An **AI power user with substance and good judgment**. You drive agents, have opinions about where today's models break down drawn from real experience, and you're actively rethinking what engineering management looks like when writing code is no longer the bottleneck. You help your team move fast with these tools without becoming dependent on them for the thinking. You know the difference between leveraging AI and outsourcing your brain to it. A **systems thinker**. You look beyond the element at hand to the broader dynamics at play. A **strong writer and compelling storyteller**. Remote work demands clear writing, clear writing is clear thinking, and clear thinking is how you get the biggest impact from AI. But clarity alone doesn't motivate people. You know how to tell the story of why the work matters, where the team is headed, and what winning looks like. A **humble, always\-a\-student approach** to management itself. You treat management as a craft you're actively learning, and you treat the changing nature of product development with the same curiosity. **Technical enough to lead engineers credibly.** You don't need to be the best engineer on the team, but you need to earn their respect, ask sharp questions in code reviews and design discussions, and provide real guidance. **Experience required:** * Track record managing software engineers on teams building full stack web applications * Demonstrated, substantive use of AI development tools in your own work, not just encouraging your team to use them * Able to work remotely from the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones * Qualified to work in the United States **What We'd Be Excited to Find** * Familiarity building and maintaining HIPAA\-compliant software * A track record of leading teams through significant shifts in tooling or process. You've helped people navigate real ambiguity and come out stronger. * Concrete examples of how you've changed your team's workflows around AI. Not just "we adopted Copilot." What did you actually do differently, and what happened? **Working Conditions** * Manual dexterity required to use desktop computer and peripherals. **Compensation and Equipment** * Salary (TBD based on job experience and skill level) * Medical insurance is covered in full for the employee (Medical, Dental, and Vision) * Company will provide laptop and other needed computer equipment **How to Apply** Apply with a brief resume and either a written or video cover letter. We review the cover letter before anything else in your application, so this really matters. This is your single biggest opportunity to improve your chances, and video submissions go right to the front of the line. **Prompt:** How has AI changed the way you think about engineering management? Not just the tools your team uses, but how you lead, what you prioritize, and what you've stopped doing. Tell us why this position is the one you've been hoping to find. **Written:** No more than 600 words. We're looking for clarity of thought and strong communication. Use AI if you want, but don't send slop. **Video:** 1–2 minutes, linked in the "Website, Blog, or Portfolio" section of your application. Doesn't need to be highly produced. We care about how you think and communicate. We strongly encourage candidates from all backgrounds and every walk of life to apply. Every person on our team brings their own unique perspective, and it's what makes our products better and our work more rewarding. We're eager to support you so that you and your team can ship work you're proud of. **Candidates only. No recruiters, please.** ***About AxisCare*** *According to Pew Research, roughly 10,000 baby boomers turn 65 every day, and the American Society on Aging calculated that an American has a 70% chance of needing help with activities of daily living such as dressing, bathing, hygiene, etc. This has led to an unprecedented increase in Home Care agencies in the U.S. and abroad who strive to help those who have difficulty helping themselves, specifically offering non\-medical (also referred to as non\-skilled) services to seniors in their homes.* *AxisCare was started in 2011 by industry leaders to help meet the demand for a more user\-friendly and mobile\-compatible solution. Our product is a web\-based management platform that helps agencies manage CRM and marketing, Caregiver/Client scheduling, billing, payroll and much more. Headquartered in Waco, TX, AxisCare has clients in all 50 states as well as 6 other countries. We are a fast\-growing company seeking high\-performing individuals looking for a fast\-paced, autonomous working environment.*

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Platform Firmware
jobs.description: **Staff Engineer, Platform Firmware Engineer** Location: San Jose, CA (On\-site) Ayar Labs is shattering AI data bottlenecks by moving data at the speed of light. As pioneers of co\-packaged optics (CPO), we are using light instead of electricity to move data faster, further, and with a fraction of the energy needed to fuel the explosive growth of AI models. Backed by industry giants like NVIDIA, AMD and Intel and manufactured in partnership with the world’s leading semiconductor ecosystem, Ayar Labs’ co\-packaged optics solution is key to unleashing next\-generation AI scale\-up architectures. We are seeking a Sr. Staff Platform Firmware Engineer to own the board\-level and platform\-emulation firmware used to enable, validate, and demonstrate Ayar Labs’ electro\-photonic products. This role focuses on firmware running on STM32\-based boards that emulate customer platforms, control external hardware, and validate embedded firmware running inside Ayar Labs’ and customers’ SoCs. This is a highly system\-oriented, hands\-on role operating at the intersection of hardware, firmware, and customer platforms, with deep influence on board design, validation strategy, and customer enablement. **What You’ll Do** * Own and evolve platform\-level firmware running on STM32\-based systems used for demos, validation, and customer enablement. * Develop firmware that controls and monitors ADCs, DACs, regulators, laser modules, and other board\-level components. * Build and maintain firmware that emulates customer platforms, enabling realistic system behavior without requiring full customer SoCs. * Support and scale firmware across multiple board designs, balancing reuse, configurability, and maintainability. * Lead board bring\-up and sign\-off, working hands\-on in the lab to validate functionality and readiness. * Review schematics and PCB designs, providing actionable feedback to the hardware team when changes materially improve firmware robustness, testability, or system reliability. * Coordinate closely with the embedded firmware team responsible for photonic IC control, ensuring clean interfaces and effective system validation. * Develop board\-level firmware that controls, exercises, and tests embedded firmware running inside Ayar Labs’ and customers’ SoCs * Partner with systems, validation, and customer\-facing teams to debug complex cross\-domain issues. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field, with 4\+ years of platform firmware experience. * Strong experience with bare\-metal platform firmware development in C. * Hands\-on experience with STM32 microcontrollers (or similar ARM\-based MCUs). * Proven experience with board bring\-up, lab debugging, and hardware/firmware integration. * Ability to review schematics and board designs and collaborate deeply with hardware teams. * Experience supporting multiple hardware platforms within a shared firmware architecture. * Proficiency with Git\-based development workflows. * Comfort operating in a fast\-paced, startup environment with high ownership. **Preferred Skills** * Experience controlling power, analog, or optical subsystems (ADCs, DACs, regulators, lasers). * Familiarity with CMIS or related optical module management protocols. * Experience developing test, diagnostic, or platform\-emulation firmware. * Exposure to customer SoC platforms, boot flows, or system bring\-up. * Experience with Make\-based build systems and Python\-based tooling. * Background in high\-speed SerDes or photonics\-adjacent systems. Salary range: $170,000 \- $210,000 NOTE TO RECRUITERS: Principals only. We are not accepting resumes from recruiters for this position. Remuneration for recruiting activities is only applicable subject to a signed and executed agreement between the parties. Please don’t send candidates to Ayar Labs, and do not contact our managers. Ayar Labs is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is strongly committed to all policies which will afford equal opportunity employment to all qualified persons without regard to age, sex, national origin, race, color, ethnicity, creed, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. It is the policy of Ayar Labs to provide reasonable accommodation when requested by a qualified applicant or employee with a disability, unless such accommodation would cause an undue hardship. Veterans are more than welcome and encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Healthcare Platform - Remote
jobs.description: **Role Summary** ---------------- We are seeking a senior AI engineer to help build and operate a production\-grade healthcare GenAI platform for patient\-facing and enterprise conversational experiences. This role will focus on backend AI services, agentic workflows, MCP tool servers, secure clinical data integrations, and AI platform tooling. The ideal candidate is a strong Python/backend engineer with hands\-on GenAI experience who can build reliable agent systems using **Google ADK**, LLM tool calling, structured outputs, RAG, guardrails, and healthcare\-safe integration patterns. This is not a prompt\-only role; it requires production engineering judgment across security, observability, testing, deployment, PHI protection, and operational ownership. **Primary Responsibilities** ---------------------------- * Design, implement, and maintain backend AI services using **Python 3\.12\+**, async service patterns, and frameworks such as **FastAPI**, **Google ADK**, and **FastMCP**. * Develop and operate agentic GenAI workflows using **Google ADK 2\.x** as a primary orchestration framework. * Build MCP tool servers and domain\-specific tools for healthcare workflows such as care tasks, medications, scheduling, patient profile lookup, clinical record retrieval, and EHR/FHIR\-backed experiences. * Integrate LLM providers and GenAI toolkits including **Google Gemini/Vertex AI**, OpenAI, Anthropic, and related orchestration frameworks where appropriate. * Implement prompt engineering, RAG, structured output validation, tool selection patterns, memory strategies, and AI guardrails to support safe and reliable model behavior. * Design secure clinical integration boundaries for FHIR, EHR, user profile, scheduling, and other healthcare systems. * Protect PHI and sensitive credentials through secure JWT/OAuth flows, delegated authorization, token forwarding, encryption, redaction, and audit\-safe logging. * Leverage cloud services such as **Azure App Configuration, Key Vault, Cosmos DB, Event Hubs, Application Insights**, and Google Cloud services such as **Vertex AI/Gemini and Cloud Run**. * Build observability, telemetry, evaluation, and impact\-reporting capabilities for AI systems and AI\-assisted engineering workflows. * Author and maintain automated tests using **pytest** and support linting, type\-checking, CI/CD, and containerized deployments. * Collaborate with product, architecture, security, clinical, platform, DevOps, and application teams to deliver safe AI capabilities through well\-defined HTTP/MCP contracts. * Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, production support, operational readiness, and incident response. **BENEFITS** Our competitive benefits package includes the following * Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits * 401(k) savings plan with dollar\-for\-dollar match up to 5% * Tuition Reimbursement * PTO accrual beginning Day 1 Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level**Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 7\+ years of professional software development experience. * Strong production experience with **Python**, asynchronous programming, backend APIs, and service\-oriented architecture. * Hands\-on experience building GenAI applications with **Google ADK 2\.x** or similar agent orchestration frameworks. * Demonstrated understanding of LLM tool calling, multi\-agent workflows, structured outputs, RAG, prompt engineering, and AI safety/guardrail patterns. * Experience integrating with LLM providers such as **Google Gemini/Vertex AI**, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent platforms. * Experience with **FastAPI**, **pytest**, Docker, CI/CD workflows, and containerized production deployments. * Strong understanding of API security, **JWT/OAuth**, delegated authorization, secrets management, and secure service\-to\-service communication. * Ability to design safe integration patterns for healthcare data, clinical systems, or other sensitive regulated environments. * Experience with cloud\-native services in Azure and/or Google Cloud. * Strong debugging, testing, and operational problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work with high ownership in a small, fast\-moving engineering team. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate across engineering, architecture, security, product, and clinical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Healthcare domain experience, especially with **HIPAA**, **HL7/FHIR**, Epic integrations, patient portals, scheduling, medication, claims, or clinical workflow systems. * Experience with **MCP**, **FastMCP v3**, model\-tool integration, or agent tool\-server architecture. * Experience with LangGraph, LangChain, PydanticAI, Semantic Kernel, or other orchestration and structured\-output frameworks. * Familiarity with **OpenTelemetry**, Application Insights, Kusto, AI evaluation pipelines, or production observability tooling. * Experience building AI platform tooling, internal developer enablement tools, AI governance automation, code review automation, or AI impact reporting. * Experience with **uv**, ruff, pyright, Python packaging, dependency isolation, and multi\-container service deployment. * Exposure to React and TypeScript for occasional full\-stack collaboration, while remaining primarily backend/platform focused. **AI\-Augmented Development Expectations** ------------------------------------------ This role requires disciplined use of AI tools as part of daily engineering work. The engineer should be able to use AI coding agents and GenAI systems to accelerate implementation, research, validation, and documentation while remaining fully accountable for correctness and safety. The successful candidate will know how to: * Give AI agents clear, scoped engineering tasks. * Require agents to inspect existing code, contracts, tests, and architecture before proposing changes. * Validate AI\-generated code with tests, type checks, linting, runtime review, and security judgment. * Identify when generated code is unsafe, incorrect, over\-engineered, noncompliant, or inconsistent with platform boundaries. * Use AI tools to improve delivery speed without compromising PHI protection, reliability, auditability, maintainability, or user trust. * Contribute to AI governance patterns, reusable agent instructions, tool ergonomics, and platform standards. **Ideal Candidate Profile** --------------------------- The ideal candidate is a senior backend/platform engineer with practical GenAI experience and strong healthcare\-grade judgment. They can design agent workflows, but they also understand authentication, deployment, observability, testing, failure modes, PHI handling, and operational ownership. They are pragmatic, security\-minded, collaborative, and comfortable building early platform foundations that will later support production patient\-facing AI experiences.

jobs.description: BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer. **General Description:** We are seeking a Sr. Principal Software and AI Engineer to serve as the senior technical authority for AI\-powered applications across drug development, with a primary focus on protocol generation and clinical trial execution. In this hands\-on senior technical leadership role, you will help shape the R\&D AI strategy and set technical direction for the engineering team, while building critical components yourself and setting best practices for AI\-native development within a disciplined, validated SDLC. You will architect and ship production\-grade agentic applications and platforms, set standards for evaluation, observability, and GxP compliance, and raise the bar for engineers through design product teams to embed AI into regulated clinical development workflows. * Shape Architecture: Define scalable, reliable platform architecture for multi\-agent orchestration, model and tool integration, and the full LLMOps lifecycle. * Set Standards: Establish best practices for AI\-native development, evaluation, testing, observability, and continuous performance monitoring within a validated SDLC. * Drive Innovation: Assess frontier and open\-weight models, agent frameworks, and tooling, and make sound build, buy, and model sourcing decisions. * Ensure Compliance: Uphold GxP, data privacy, security, and responsible AI standards, with traceability, auditability, and human oversight built into every system. **Supervisory Responsibilities:** * Act as tech lead with full ownership of product development, accountable for technical direction, delivery, and quality from concept through production. * Lead project execution, setting priorities, scope, and timelines for the AI engineering team. * Mentor AI and software engineers through design and code reviews, reference implementations, and hands\-on guidance. * Lead cross\-functional technical workstreams with clinical, medical writing, biostatistics, and clinical operations partners. **Foundational Background** * **Education:** Bachelors with 7\+ years, Masters with 5\+ years or PhD with 3\+ years * **Experience:** Software and AI/ML engineering experience, including experience as a tech lead or principal engineer owning large\-scale AI products end to end. Experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry is strongly preferred. * **Track Record:** Proven success shipping production\-grade AI and agentic applications that deliver measurable scientific or business impact, ideally in a regulated environment. **Core Technical Expertise** * **Full\-Stack Software Engineering:** A strong software engineer first. Deep backend expertise in Python (preferred) and/or .NET, with a track record of architecting and building enterprise applications end to end across frontend, APIs, databases, and deployment. Hands\-on experience with relational, search, and graph data stores such as PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Neo4j. Sound judgment in system design, data modeling, and production operations. * **Multi\-Agent, AI\-Native Applications:** Deep, hands\-on experience architecting and shipping multi\-agent applications to production, with strong command of agent harness design, context engineering, orchestration, tool integration (including MCP), and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. * **Frontier Model Application:** Strong judgment in selecting and applying frontier and open\-weight models, using structured outputs, guardrails, and validation to ensure stable, robust model behavior. Experience with fine\-tuning or post\-training is a plus. * **Knowledge Engineering:** Proven ability to design and manage enterprise knowledge architecture, including ontology design, knowledge graphs, and retrieval, to make domain knowledge structured, governed, and usable by AI systems. * **Evaluation and Reliability:** Proven ability to build multi\-layered evaluation, from expert benchmarks and rule\-based checks to human review and model\-based grading, backed by production monitoring. * **AI\-Assisted Development:** Fluency with AI coding tools and practices, applied within a disciplined SDLC with rigorous testing, code review, and CI/CD. * **Platform and Infrastructure:** Strong knowledge of LLMOps, secure cloud deployment (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and observability. **Clinical Development Domain** * **Protocol and Trial Execution:** Experience with clinical protocol development, study design, or clinical trial operations. Familiarity with ICH M11 structured protocols, CDISC standards, or USDM is a strong plus. * **Regulated AI:** Working knowledge of GxP, computer system validation, and emerging regulatory guidance on AI in drug development. **Leadership and Collaboration** * Proven ability to act as tech lead, owning product direction and delivery while mentoring senior engineers. * Strong partnership with clinicians, medical writers, statisticians, and clinical operations, translating complex AI concepts for research, regulatory, and executive audiences. * Deep commitment to data privacy, security, and responsible AI in development and deployment. **Travel:** 10% Global Competencies When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world. * Fosters Teamwork * Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback * Self\-Awareness * Acts Inclusively * Demonstrates Initiative * Entrepreneurial Mindset * Continuous Learning * Embraces Change * Results\-Oriented * Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis * Financial Excellence * Communicates with Clarity Salary Range: $137,400\.00 \- $182,400\.00 annually BeOne is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Packages may vary by location due to differences in the cost of labor. The recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for a preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that the listed range reflects the base salary or hourly range only. jobs.title: Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Cyngn, Inc.** Based in Mountain View, CA, Cyngn is a publicly\-traded autonomous technology company. We deploy self\-driving industrial vehicles \-**specifically autonomous tuggers**\- to factories, warehouses, and other facilities throughout North America. To build this emergent technology, we are looking for innovative, motivated, and experienced leaders to join us and move this field forward. If you like to build, tinker, and create with a team of trusted and passionate colleagues, then Cyngn is the place for you. **Key reasons to join Cyngn:** **We are small and big.** With under 100 employees, Cyngn operates with the energy of a startup. On the other hand, we’re publicly traded. This means our employees not only work in close\-knit teams with mentorship from company leaders—they also get access to the liquidity of our publicly\-traded equity. **We build today and deploy tomorrow.** Our autonomous vehicles aren’t just test concepts—they’re deployed to real clients right now. That means your work will have a tangible, visible impact. **We aren’t robots. We just develop them.** We’re a welcoming, diverse team of sharp thinkers and kind humans. Collaboration and trust drive our creative environment. At Cyngn, everyone’s perspective matters—and that’s what powers our innovation. **About the role** As a **Senior Robotics Systems Software Engineer on Cyngn’s Autonomy team**, you will develop, integrate, and deploy software across the autonomous driving stack for our industrial vehicles. This role is ideal for a strong robotics generalist who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. Depending on the problem, you may contribute to behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, localization, perception interfaces, simulation, or vehicle integration. You will work closely with engineers across autonomy, vehicle infrastructure, hardware, QA, and deployment to turn robotics algorithms into reliable production systems operating on autonomous tuggers and forklifts at customer sites. **What you'll do** * Design, develop, test, and deploy software for autonomous industrial vehicles across areas including behavior and decision\-making, motion planning, controls, and vehicle systems. * Write and maintain production\-quality C\+\+ and Python software running on Cyngn’s autonomous vehicle platforms. * Develop and integrate algorithms for navigation, trajectory generation, vehicle control, obstacle handling, and autonomous behaviors. * Integrate autonomy software with sensors, drive\-by\-wire systems, vehicle hardware, and other onboard software components. * Bring up, validate, and debug software on real vehicles, tracing issues across autonomy modules, middleware, hardware interfaces, and vehicle behavior. * Develop simulation scenarios, testing infrastructure, metrics, and regression tests to validate autonomy behavior before deployment. * Investigate field issues and edge cases, reproduce failures, identify root causes, and implement robust production solutions. * Support deployment and validation of autonomous vehicles at customer facilities, translating real\-world observations into improvements across the autonomy stack. * Collaborate closely with engineers in Planning, Controls, Perception, Localization, Vehicle Infrastructure, Hardware, QA, and Operations. * Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design, and continuous improvement of Cyngn’s autonomy software. **Priorities: 3\-6\-12 Month Goals** **First 90 Days** * Build a working understanding of Cyngn’s autonomy architecture, simulation environment, vehicle platforms, development workflow, and deployment process. * Partner with engineers across autonomy, infrastructure, hardware, QA, and operations to trace representative vehicle behaviors, build working relationships, and identify high\-value reliability, integration, and test\-coverage risks. * Deliver one scoped production improvement—such as fixing a well\-understood autonomy defect, adding a regression scenario, or improving diagnostic tooling—and validate it in simulation and, where appropriate, on a vehicle. * Propose a prioritized plan for addressing one or two larger cross\-stack risks, including candidate success metrics, data sources, and how each metric will be measured. **By 6 Months** * Complete a production\-quality autonomy improvement that spans two or more subsystem boundaries and has been accepted into a release candidate and/or at production customer sites. * Establish the agreed baseline metrics and demonstrate early improvement, such as improved scenario pass rate, fewer interventions, reduced tracking error, or faster failure resolution. * Add reusable simulation scenarios, regression tests, diagnostics, or validation tools that are incorporated into the team’s release\-candidate testing. * Publish a technical design or process improvement that is reviewed and adopted by the affected teams. **By 12 Months** * Demonstrate sustained, measurable etrics, and CI/CD infrastructure for robotic systems. * Familiarity with Linux, Git, Docker, CMake, and modern software development workflows. * Experience taking robotics functionality from prototype through validation and production deployment. ### **Benefits \& Perks** * Health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision) through Aetna, Kaiser Permanente, and Guardian, with multiple plan tiers to choose from * Ancillary benefits including accident, critical illness, and hospital indemnity plans (Voya) * Company\-paid basic life insurance, plus voluntary (supplemental) life for you and your dependents * Short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, fully paid by Cyngn * HSA and FSA (Health \& Dependent Daycare) * Employee Assistance Program * 1:1 Health Concierge * Company 401(k) * Commuter Benefits * Flexible PTO policy * Paid Parental Leave * Daily lunches for in\-office employees and fully\-stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages ### **What You Can Expect (Cyngn’s interview process)** * A real person will review your application * We’ll kick off the process with a one\-sided video interview where you’ll share a little more about yourself and we’ll get some basic questions out of the way * A Recruiter touch point will go over the process in more detail and answer your questions * A 45\-minute interview with the hiring manager * A full\-loop interview process consisting of 3\-4 additional conversations to gauge technical and soft skills and culture fit. * A final onsite interview with the team. *W**e may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.* ***Equal Opportunity Employer*** *Cyngn is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, familial status, military or veteran status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, compensation, benefits, training, promotion, discipline, and termination.* *If you require accommodation during the application or interview process due to a disability, please let us know and we will work with you to provide reasonable accommodation* ***A Note on Recruitment Scams*** *We've seen an increase in fraudulent job offers and phishing attempts impersonating real companies, including Cyngn.* *To protect yourself:* * *All official communication from Cyngn recruiters and hiring managers will come from an email address ending in* ***@cyngn.com****. We will never contact you from a personal email (Gmail, Yahoo, etc.) or via unsolicited text message or messaging app.* * *Cyngn will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, background checks, or any other fees as part of the application or hiring process.* * *We will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information (e.g., bank account or Social Security number) before you've been extended and have accepted a formal offer through official channels.* * *If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Cyngn, please do not respond with personal information, and feel free to verify by reaching out to us directly through our official careers page.* The pay range for this role is: 180,000 \- 200,000 USD per year (HQ \- Terra Bella)

and maintain backend services, workflows, integrations, and APIs supporting commerce applications. * Develop services primarily using C\#/.NET, Java/Spring Boot, and TypeScript/Node.js based on platform and business needs. * Apply object\-oriented design and established software engineering principles to create maintainable, scalable, and testable systems. * Build services supporting order management, inventory, payments, tax, loyalty, customer identity, product data, and related commerce capabilities. * Extend and integrate modular headless commerce platforms such as Medusa, and design repetitive work by improving architecture, documentation, tooling, guardrails, and automation. Continuously identify manual or repetitive work that can be safely delegated, automated, or supported by AI while retaining responsibility for the final outcome. * **TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES (Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities)** * Strong knowledge of object\-  and backend\-for\-frontend architecture. * Working knowledge of relational database design and development using SQL Server or PostgreSQL, including schema design, migrations, normalization, and query troubleshooting. * Working knowledge of Git, automated testing, containers, CI/CD, observability, and cloud infrastructure, preferably Microsoft Azure. * Knowledge of distributed\-system reliability concepts such as retries, idempotency, reconciliation, transaction integrity, fault handling, and secure data exchange. Practical knowledge of modern AI development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar coding agents. * **Skills \& Abilities** * Ability to translate business and technical requirements into secure, reliable, maintainable, and scalable software solutions. * Ability to investigate ambiguous problems systematically and diagnose issues spanning applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and infrastructure. * Ability to create implementation plans, define acceptance criteria, estimate work, identify dependencies, and communicate technical risks and trade\-offs. * Ability to critically evaluate AI\-generated architecture and code and remain accountable for correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and design. * Ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate across technical and nontechnical teams, and deliver results in an environment that includes modern cloud services and legacy platforms. Ability to document systems, decisions, operating procedures, and previously undocumented technical knowledge clearly. * **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience required. * Minimum four years of professional software engineering experience building production applications, backend services, or enterprise integrations required. * Experience building REST APIs, services, middleware, or integration layers and working with relational databases required. * Experience developing automated tests and using Git and modern CI/CD practices required. * Demonstrated hands\-on use of modern AI development tools for analysis, planning, implementation, debugging, testing, documentation, or refactoring required. * Experience with eCommerce, order management, payments, inventory, SAP integrations, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, headless commerce, Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes preferred. Experience migrating functionality from legacy or monolithic platforms and building reliable high\-volume integrations preferred. * **DISCLAIMER** This job description indicates, in general terms, the type and level of work performed as well as the typical responsibilities of employees in this classification, and it may be changed by management at any time. jobs.description: About the Role: Located near a Canon facility (San Jose, CA; Dallas, TX; or Phoenix, AZ) the Technical Support Engineer will provide technical support for software related issues. This is an exciting opportunity for creative candidates with mechanical knowledge who enjoy a technical challenge. You will work in various customer sites nationwide, to setup and upgrade software in our semiconductor equipment, troubleshoot software related issues, and partner with customers to setup/select optional functions and troubleshoot automation settings. If you have experience with SECS/GEM automation and enjoy resolving technical challenges, this could be the job for you! Your Impact: \- Organize and track both computer hardware and software configuration on all products in the field. \- Liaison with local, domestic and overseas software design team regarding software and/or automation related problems in the field \- Set up hardware, install and configure software, drivers and peripheral devices with knowledge of networking components \- Discuss with customers about Semiconductor equipment automation specifications (SECS/GEM Software compliance) About You: The Skills \& Expertise You Bring: \- Bachelor’s degree in an engineering discipline required plus 5 years of related experience, or a Masters degree preferably in an Engineering discipline. \- Attention to detail with excellent communication skills \- Japanese language skills a plus \- Excellent leadership skills required \- Familiar with SQL, UNIX, LINUX environment and scripting languages \- Understanding of networking fundamentals and concepts \- Knowledge of semiconductor automation system in SEMI SECS/GEM \- Strong understanding of software languages and computer hardware. \- Solid understanding in data structures and algorithms \- Experience in developing or debugging software applications \- Up to 50% overnight travel required (domestic and/or international) dependent on business needs. jobs.description: **About Carrier** Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting\-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. This role serves as the technical authority for software quality and engineering excellence, ensuring all software solutions, whether developed by internal teams, external partners, or AI\-assisted development tools, meet enterprise standards for security, maintainability, scalability, performance, reliability, and reusability. technology roadmaps. * Identify opportunitiesto reduce technical debt and improve overall platform quality. **Performance Engineering** * Define performance engineering standards and optimization jobs.title: Control Systems Senior Engineer
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Engineering**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. This job involves designing, developing and testing embedded control system features for Caterpillar products. Control systems engineers will utilize a variety of tools to support all steps of the embedded software development process. Our section has 120 features in production on a wide variety of Caterpillar models focused on machine performance and operator assistance. Features include Transmission Automatic Gear Selection, Machine Speed Limiter, Traction Control, AutoCarry and Auto Set Tires. This position is on the transmission controls technology team. Our talented team needs your help to support the current and innovate the next generation of control features. **What You Will Do:** * Gather product and system requirements to further specify and document control system requirements. * Design embedded control systems to meet functional and system requirements. This may involve improving existing features or innovating new ones. Designs will support strategic architectural initiatives like Autosar, modularity and reuse. * Lead the implementation and delivery of software components to meet design specifications with strong quality assurance. Core functions are all model\-based implementations in Simulink. * Test, tune and debug embedded system software using a variety of methods and tools to demonstrate requirements, optimize system performance, and improve code quality. Methods include Model\-in\-the\-Loop, Software\-in\-the\-Loop, Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop and on\-machine testing. * Collaborate with clients and partner teams to provide post\-production support. **What Skills You Will Have:** * **Requirements Analysis:** Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non\-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. * **Embedded Systems:** Knowledge of embedded systems and their applications; ability to develop embedded systems with varying levels of complexity to control the operations of the machine it is embedded within. * **Product Testing:** Knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques and tools; ability to design, plan and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure product quality at all stages of manufacturing. * **Technical Troubleshooting:** Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. **Top Candidates Will Have:** * BS or MS in Electrical, Mechanical or Computer Engineering, or Computer Science * Experience with requirements, software specification, and workflow management * Well\-versed in version control and configuration management tools for software development * Demonstrated delivery of real\-time embedded control systems software in the transmission domain with MATLAB / Simulink / Stateflow for automotive or machine (mobile equipment) applications * Proficiency with AUTOSAR and generating AUTOSAR\-compliant code from Simulink * Knowledge of software testing methods like Model\-in\-the\-Loop, Software\-in\-the\-Loop and Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop * Familiarity with testing tools like Vector Network Interfaces, CANape and CANalyzer * Working knowledge of machine systems like engines / power systems and multi\-speed drivetrains * Ability to lead and mentor engineers on a software development team * Motivation to operate heavy construction machinery at proving ground or field sites **Additional Information:** * Location is onsite in Mossville, IL five days per week * Relocation assistance may be available in accordance with Caterpillar policies. * Sponsorship is not available for this position. * Travel is 10% \#LI **Summary Pay Range:** $112,710\.00 \- $169,060\.00 Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar. **Benefits:** Subject to plan eligibility, terms, and guidelines. This is a summary list of benefits. * Medical, dental, and vision benefits\* * Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holidays, Volunteer, etc.)\* * 401(k) savings plans\* * Health Savings Account (HSA)\* * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)\* * Health Lifestyle Programs\* * Employee Assistance Program\* * Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts\* * Career Development\* * Incentive bonus\* * Disability benefits * Life Insurance * Parental leave * Adoption benefits * Tuition Reimbursement * These benefits also apply to part\-time employees This position requires working onsite five days a week. Relocation is available for this position. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.**Posting Dates:** October 16, 2026 \- November 2, 2026 Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen. Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply. Not ready to apply? Join our Talent Community.

jobs.title: Technical Leader- Platform Security
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/29/2026Meet the Team Our Platform Security team is at the heart of protecting the infrastructure that powers the internet. We are a group of specialized engineers focused on building the secure foundation for next\-generation networking. From silicon bring\-up to the OS layer, we collaborate across disciplines to ensure that security is not just an add\-on, but a fundamental part of our platform architecture. Your Impact As a Technical Leader, you will serve as the primary authority on platform security, steering the architecture, development, and integration of robust security solutions. You will work across the full stack—from hardware and firmware to Linux and networking operating systems like SONiC—to establish a secure chain of trust. Your leadership will define how we protect our platforms throughout their entire lifecycle, ensuring integrity from manufacturing through production deployment. Responsibilities * Define comprehensive platform security strategies, including Root of Trust, Secure/Measured Boot, attestation, firmware integrity, and key lifecycle management. * Drive the implementation of UEFI Secure Boot (PK, KEK, db, dbx), including enrollment, rotation, revocation, and debug processes. * Integrate security protocols into Linux and SONiC environments, focusing on ONIE, kernel integrity, driver security, and firmware update mechanisms. * Define and manage manufacturing and field provisioning of keys and certificates to ensure platform identity. * Conduct thorough platform threat modeling, lead security reviews, and provide mentorship to engineering teams across hardware, firmware, and software domains. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree with 8 years of related experience, or Master’s degree with 6 years of related experience, or PhD with 3 years of related experience. * Minimum 5 years of experience in C/C\+\+ and Python/shell, with demonstrated ability to debug across firmware, Linux, and hardware layers. * Minimum 8 years of experience in platform, firmware, or system security. * Minimum 5 years of specific expertise in UEFI Secure Boot, Linux boot/kernel architectures, and hardware Root of Trust (TPM or equivalent). * 8 years of strong Linux system expertise, covering boot processes, kernels, drivers, and firmware interfaces within SONiC or similar networking operating systems. Preferred Qualifications ✨ * Experience with OpenBMC, Caliptra/DICE, or PKI/X.509 standards. * Proficiency in kernel/module signing and working with NPU platforms. * Familiarity with FIPS/Common Criteria compliance or relevant open\-source security contributions. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
