jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist – Generative AI & LLM Engineering
jobs.description: **Practice \- AIA \- Artificial Intelligence and Analytics** **About AI \& Analytics:** Artificial intelligence (AI) and the data it collects and analyzes will soon sit at the core of all intelligent, human\-centric businesses. By decoding customer needs, preferences, and behaviors, our clients can understand exactly what services, products, and experiences their consumers need. Within AI \& Analytics, we work to design the future—a future in which trial\-and\-error business decisions have been replaced by informed choices and data\-supported strategies. By applying AI and data science, we help leading companies to prototype, refine, validate, and scale their AI and analytics products and delivery model s. Cognizant’s AIA practice takes insights that are buried in data and provides businesses a clear way to transform how they source, interpret and consume their information. Our clients need flexible data structures and a streamlined data architecture that quickly turns data resources into informative, meaningful intelligence. **Job Summary** We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist with strong expertise in Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA), Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models (LLMs). This role will focus on designing, tuning, evaluating, optimizing, and deploying enterprise\-scale AI/ML solutions while contributing to the broader AI architecture roadmap. The ideal candidate will combine strong statistical and machine learning foundations with hands\-on experience in RAG, LLM tuning, AI agents, model evaluation, and production AI platforms. **In this role, you will:** * Perform advanced Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and statistical analysis to identify patterns, relationships, anomalies, and actionable business insights. * Design, develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for predictive analytics, classification, regression, forecasting, and other enterprise use cases. * Build Generative AI and LLM\-based solutions, including RAG applications, AI agents, enterprise search, and knowledge\-driven AI systems. * Fine\-tune, profile, benchmark, and optimize LLMs for model quality, latency, accuracy, scalability, and cost efficiency. * Design model evaluation frameworks covering performance, relevance, hallucination, safety, robustness, and business effectiveness. * Contribute to end\-to\-end AI/ML architecture across cloud and on\-premises environments, including model serving, data pipelines, and integration patterns. * Develop and operationalize MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for experimentation, versioning, deployment, monitoring, and continuous model improvement. * Evaluate AI/ML frameworks, foundation models, vector databases, and emerging technologies based on business and technical requirements. * Collaborate with data engineers, AI engineers, architects, product teams, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable AI solutions. * Ensure AI solutions follow enterprise security, data governance, responsible AI, and production\-readiness standards. **What you need to have to be considered** * 6\+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning, AI Engineering, or Advanced Analytics roles. * Expert knowledge of Exploratory Data Analysis, statistical methods, feature engineering, machine learning algorithms, and model evaluation techniques. * 3\+ years of strong hands\-on Machine Learning experience developing and deploying production\-grade models. * Hands\-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, vector databases, model tuning, evaluation, and performance optimization. * Strong proficiency in Python and ML/AI frameworks such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit\-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent technologies. * Experience with LLM fine\-tuning approaches, model benchmarking, inference optimization, and responsible AI practices. * Familiarity with AI agents, multi\-agent systems, MLOps/LLMOps, model monitoring, and enterprise AI platform architecture. * Experience with major cloud AI/ML platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and production deployment practices. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills with the ability to translate technical results into business outcomes. **\#LI\-EF1** **\#CB** **\#Ind123** Applications will be accepted until 30 Oct 2026\. **Salary and Other Compensation:** The annual salary for this position is between $\[133,000 \- 156,500] depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. Benefits: Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: * Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance * Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off * 401(k) plan and contributions * Long\-term/Short\-term Disability * Paid Parental Leave * Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Sr. Python & Java Developer
jobs.description: ### **About the Role** We are seeking a professional to design and implement secure and scalable card and payment processing services using python java and aws to support high volume transactions and consistent customer experiences. The successful candidate will also develop and optimize microservices and application components that enable real time authorization settlement and reconciliation while meeting strict performance and reliability targets. Strong communication, problem\-solving, and the ability to translate requirements into effective delivery are important for success in this position. ### **In This Role, You Will** * Design and implement secure and scalable card and payment processing services using Python Java and AWS to support high volume transactions and consistent customer experiences. * Develop and optimize microservices and application components that enable real time authorization settlement and reconciliation while meeting strict performance and reliability targets. * Collaborate with product managers architects and domain experts to refine functional and non functional requirements for card and payment features and translate them into clear technical designs. * Integrate applications with internal and external payment gateways card networks and fraud management systems while ensuring compliance with industry standards and organizational policies. * Conduct thorough code reviews and provide constructive feedback to maintain high coding standards reusable components and robust design patterns across Python and Java services. * Implement automated testing strategies including unit integration and end to end tests to ensure high\-quality releases and reduce production incidents in card and payment platforms. * Configure and maintain AWS based infrastructure such as compute storage and databases to achieve resilient cost efficient and observable environments for payment applications. * Monitor production systems using logging metrics and alerts to proactively detect performance bottlenecks and service degradation and drive timely remediation actions. * Work closely with operations and support teams to analyze incident trends in card and payment services and implement sustainable fixes that enhance platform stability and customer trust. * Document system architectures service interfaces and deployment procedures to enable clear knowledge sharing and smoother onboarding for engineering and operations teams. * Participate in hybrid model collaboration ceremonies including design discussions and sprint events to ensure alignment on delivery priorities and technical decisions. * Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging tools and practices in Python Java and AWS that can strengthen card and payment capabilities and reduce operational overhead. * Ensure that all solutions uphold data privacy security controls and regulatory requirements within the cards and payments domain to protect customers and the organization. ### **Work Model** We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position open to qualified applicants able to work in Richmond, VA. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting and may change based on business and client requirements. ***Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship. \*Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or sponsorship now or in the future\**** ### **What You Need to Have to Be Considered** * Apply deep expertise in Python to build performant backend services scripts and data processing components tailored for card and payment workflows. * Use solid Java experience to maintain and enhance core transaction engines APIs and integration layers that handle large scale card and payment operations. * Leverage strong AWS skills to design cloud native architectures including appropriate use of compute storage network and managed services for payment platforms. * Demonstrate proven experience in cards and payments domain including understanding of transaction lifecycles settlement chargeback and regulatory compliance requirements. * Employ sound software engineering practices such as version control code review continuous integration and deployment to deliver maintainable and reliable systems. * Communicate effectively with cross functional teams sharing domain insights technical considerations and operational impacts to support informed decision making. * Adapt to hybrid work arrangements by using collaboration tools and clear documentation to maintain productivity and engagement across onsite and remote settings. ### **These Will Help You Stand Out** We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role. ### **Salary and Other Compensation** The annual salary for this position is between $120,000 \- $140,000 depending on experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. This position is also eligible for Cognizant’s discretionary annual incentive program, based on performance and subject to the terms of Cognizant’s applicable plans. ### **Benefits** Cognizant offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical/Dental/Vision/Life Insurance Paid holidays plus Paid Time Off 401(k) plan and contributions Long\-term/Short\-term Disability Paid Parental Leave Employee Stock Purchase Plan

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer (Test)
jobs.description: Overview: This position sits within our Product Development division, which develops, tests, and improves our software solutions in an innovative and collaborative environment. **The Opportunity** A Senior Software Development Engineer (Test) at ConstructConnect is a developer with the primary responsibility of ensuring software quality. This is predominantly done through developing test strategies, creating / updating test automation code, executing tests (both automated and manual), and analyzing / troubleshooting defects. It is a unique and challenging role that combines the "building" aspect of software development with the "breaking" aspect of software testing. While they are responsible for all quality activities within their team, the focus is on collaboration and writing code that automatically verifies application changes. Senior SDET’s are expected to have expertise both in software development and software testing practices. They collaborate with product development teams to ensure the delivery of high quality, high value product features. They understand how our customers use our products and applications, and the technical implementation of them. They ensure our sites, products, and platforms perform to industry\-beating quality levels by designing, developing, and maintaining automated solutions in Python / Pytest that support the development, testing, and deployment of our software solutions. They are constantly seeking to improve the quality, efficiency, and reliability of our platforms. Senior SDET’s are expected to perform job functions independently and support other team members through mentoring, code reviews, paired programming, training, feedback, etc. This position sits in our Peachtree Corners location of Metro Atlanta on a hybrid basis every Tuesday and Wednesday each week. Responsibilities: **What You’ll Be Doing** * Be an expert in your product and applications * Own all quality activities for your product and applications – including test planning, test execution, reporting, and troubleshooting * Create and maintain automated tests in Python / Pytest * Be a leader and example of implementing Quality Engineering best practices (TDD, CI/CD, etc) * Lead implementing and enhancing organizational automation frameworks * Actively participate in design and code inspections to design and implement stable, testable, high\-quality services and functionality. * Contribute to the application technical roadmaps * Review static code analysis reporting such as SonarQube or Veracode to identify problematic areas of codebases and collaborate with other engineers to remediate. * Lead Proof of Concepts (POC) for new Quality Engineering technologies and tools * Be an example and provide mentoring and guidance to other team members * Participate in peer reviews and ensure coding standards are adhered to by other team members * Be a cultural leader for the team, including collaborating with other software engineers to identify team improvements that increase velocity or quality * Operate within an Agile framework, adapting to iterative development cycles and contributing to scrum ceremonies * Pursue continuous learning and professional development to stay abreast of industry standards and new technologies * This job description in no way implies that the duties listed here are the only ones that team members can be required to perform Qualifications: **What You Bring to the Team** * BS degree in Computer Sciences, programming or a related discipline or demonstrable equivalent experience * 5\+ years software testing or development experience with 5\+ years hands\-on coding experience in object\-oriented programming languages such as Python, C\#, and/or Java, Python required * Expert understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming Principles, Data Structures, and Algorithms * The ability to keep current with the constantly changing technology industry. * A passion for design, development, and testing * Expert understanding of Agile processes and workflow * Capable of analyzing issues in existing code and providing root cause analysis as well as remedy options * AI \- Claude Code and Codex experience * Demonstrated success in mentoring and/or leading team members * Experience using test automation tools and frameworks such as Pytest, Selenium, etc is a plus * Strong understanding of modern software testing practices * Excellent verbal, interpersonal, and written communication skills * Team player with the ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and multi\-task efficiently * Sound business ethics, including the protection of proprietary and confidential information * Ability to collaborate with developers on architectural\-level issues such as data flows, exception handling, and resilienc **Physical Demands and Work Environment:*** The physical activities of this position include frequent sitting, telephone communication, and working on a computer for extended periods of time. Visual acuity is required to perform activities close to the eyes. * Team members are expected to maintain a dedicated and ergonomically appropriate remote workspace. * Team members who live within commuting distance of our office location(Atlanta, Georgia) are expected to work in a hybrid capacity, with regular in\-office presence every Tuesday and Wednesday each week. * All team members must reside and perform their work within the United States **E\-Verify Statement** ConstructConnect utilizes the E\-Verify program with every potential new hire. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role** CrowdStrike is looking for a Sr. Software Engineer \- MarTech to join our fast\-growing Marketing IT team. engineering, tool calling, and orchestration. * Familiarity with marketing business domain in Hi\-Tech industry. * Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector or hybrid search, and ML\-based entity resolution, classification, or scoring. * Experience with evaluation methods, prompt and model versioning, and production monitoring. * Strong Python and SQL, plus TypeScript/JavaScript or Java, and and mentor technical and non\-technical colleagues. * Ability to balance project work with operational tasks and to work Pacific Time (PT) business hours. **Nice to Haves** * Experience with Adobe jobs.title: Security Engineering Team Lead
jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Come join the company at the center of how the world adopts AI securely. Cyera’s mission is to give enterprises the confidence to embrace AI safely — deciding exactly what it can see and do as it reaches deeper into the business. We started by solving the hardest problem in data security: finding and securing data faster and more precisely than anyone thought possible. That foundation is now the essential AI trust infrastructure for the Fortune 1000\. We’re hiring mission\-driven talent to put those leaders at the center of our story. THE OPPORTUNITY Join our team as the Security Engineering Team Lead. You will lead the engineers who build the platforms our security program runs on, set technical direction, and own the architecture and roadmap for log pipelines and SIEM, detection and automation, AWS security, SaaS security, AI security, and security tooling. You will partner closely with the Security Operations Team Lead so that what operations needs is what engineering builds. This is a player\-coach role: you lead the team and stay hands\-on. The ideal candidate has 5 or more years in security or cloud security engineering, including senior or lead\-level experience, has owned the design of security platforms at scale, and has led or mentored engineers. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Team Leadership:** Lead, coach, and develop the Security Engineering team; set priorities, run the engineering cadence, and build career paths. **Technical Direction:** Own the architecture and roadmap for the security platforms and make and document the major design decisions. **Cloud Security Architecture:** Set the security architecture for our AWS environment: identity guardrails, logging and monitoring, and posture management. **Detection and Automation Platform:** Own the detection\-as\-code framework and the automation and agent tooling the SOC depends on. **Agentic Fleet Management:** Build and run the platform behind our fleet of security agents: tooling and integrations, permissions and guardrails, evaluation and logging, and the reliability of the whole system. **Quality Bar:** Run design and code review and define engineering standards for testing, infrastructure as code, and observability. **Operations Partnership:** Translate escalation patterns and incident findings into an engineering roadmap with the Security Operations Team Lead. **Hands\-On Work:** Take the hardest technical problems yourself, with AI\-assisted development as the default way of working. **Stakeholder Management:** Represent Security Engineering to security leadership, R\&D, and IT, and make the case for investments with data. **Requirements:** **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** **Experience:** 5 or more years in security engineering, cloud security, or detection engineering, including senior or lead\-level work. **Leadership:** Experience leading, mentoring, or managing engineers. **AI\-Assisted Workflows:** Hands\-on experience building LLM\-based or agent\-based workflows and the tooling around them, and using AI\-assisted development as a normal part of engineering. **Architecture:** Experience owning the design of security platforms at scale: log pipelines, detection frameworks, cloud security controls. **AWS Depth:** Deep knowledge of AWS security architecture, IAM, organizations and guardrails, and security services. **AWS Certification:** AWS Security Specialty or Solutions Architect Associate, or equivalent demonstrated depth. **Engineering Depth:** Strong Python and infrastructure as code, with a record of shipping production systems. **Communication:** Writes clear design documents and explains Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements. This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors. In addition to a standard benefits and equity package, we offer a generous salary. Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements. This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors. ﻿BENEFITS \- Why Cyera? Unlimited PTO Paid holidays and sick time Health, vision, and dental insurance Life, short and long\-term disability insurance

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Product
jobs.description: **About Decagon** Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry\-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world\-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others. We’re an in\-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team. **About the Team** Product Engineering at Decagon builds all aspects of the platform our customers use to create, operate, and improve their AI agents. We turn work that currently requires an engineer into product that a CX team can run themselves. This team is core to how Decagon scales. The frameworks we build support every agent we have in production, each with its own workflows, data, and constraints. We build the agents too, and that’s what keeps the platform honest: a failure mode we debug in production becomes a guardrail, an eval, or a piece of tooling that catches it everywhere. Our agents run for companies like Hertz, American Airlines, and Notion across chat, voice, email, and SMS. **About the Role** You’ll design and build the systems that let customers configure, train, test, and monitor sophisticated AI agents with confidence. That means strong engineering underneath, and abstractions on top that hold up across different use cases without forking per customer. You’ll work day to day with product and design: joining discovery, defining requirements, reviewing designs, and iterating through launch. You’ll stay close enough to customers to understand their use cases in depth and to ensure what you’re building is actually right for them. Engineers here own features end to end, from technical architecture through deployment and the iteration after it. **In this role, you will** * Eliminate manual work by building self\-serve functionality for agent configuration, training, and deployment * Design configuration abstractions that balance power and simplicity, handling diverse enterprise use cases while staying usable by non\-technical teams * Build AI\-powered tooling that lets CX and ops teams create and manage complex agent workflows without writing code * Build monitoring, tracing, and analytics that surface actionable signal, so customers can see where an agent is failing and why * Handle agentic systems at scale; your work will touch critical flows for Fortune 100 companies. * Run evaluations on new text and voice models, then integrate the ones that win into production traffic **Your background and skillset look something like this** * 4\+ years building software products, with strong product thinking * Proficient in Python, comfortable working across the entire stack * Experience translating complex technical capabilities into simple, usable interfaces * Complex systems instincts, including asynchronous programming and the failure modes that only appear at scale * A high degree of comfort debugging system failures in deep technology stacks, using whatever tool gets you to the answer * A knack for turning customer asks into clear, well\-scoped product and technical specs * Judgment about when to ship fast and when to slow down and build it correctly **Even better** * Background with LLMs, prompt engineering, evals, or AI agent systems * Experience building developer tools, APIs, platforms, or internal tools that became customer\-facing * Experience with observability, data visualization, or analytics products * Experience building security\-sensitive product systems, such as authentication and data access controls * Work with multi\-modal or voice models **Compensation** $200K – $400K \+ Offers Equity This range reflects the expected compensation for this role. Compensation within the range is determined based on experience, skills, and the scope of responsibilities, with flexibility for candidates who demonstrate exceptional impact. In addition to base salary, we offer competitive equity. Final compensation may vary based on location within the United States. **Benefits** We proudly offer the following benefits for our full\-time employees: * Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family * Life Insurance and Disability Benefits * Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension) * Parental Leave * Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot * Monthly stipend to support your wellness, lifestyle, and work\-life balance * Daily lunches and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Take what you need vacation policy (subject to local requirements; UK employees receive 25 days of statutory leave) *These benefits are described in more detail in Decagon’s policies, may vary by location, and can change at any time according to applicable compensation and benefits plans.* Compensation Range: $200K \- $400K

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Data - Experimentation
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ The Decision Systems team helps DoorDash teams make faster, more rigorous, and more trustworthy decisions. We build the analytical systems, statistical methods, and product experiences that power experimentation, causal inference, rollout analysis, metric interpretation, and business impact measurement across DoorDash's three\-sided marketplace. Curie is DoorDash's experiment analysis product within Decision Systems. It sits at the center of how teams move from hypothesis to analysis to confident action, helping decision makers understand experiments, rollouts, metric movements, and marketplace impact while preserving scientific rigor, velocity, trust, and interpretability. Our work spans experimentation platforms, causal inference, variance reduction, switchback experimentation, metric systems, and AI\-assisted analysis workflows. We partner closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers, and operators across DoorDash to translate advanced methods into reliable, scalable systems that improve decision quality and product velocity. Some of the work done in the team was published in articles such as: Design\-Aware Variance Reduction for Switchback Experiments: A Comparative Study, Power\-Optimal Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments, CUPED on Steroids: Multivariate Covariate Adjustment for Switchback Experiments. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Staff Applied Scientist to provide scientific leadership for DoorDash's Experimentation Platform. In this role, you will define and advance the statistical, causal inference, machine learning, and AI capabilities that power high\-quality decision\-making across DoorDash. You will work on challenging problems at the intersection of experimentation, marketplace dynamics, machine learning, and product engineering. Your work will shape how DoorDash teams design experiments, analyze results, interpret noisy marketplace outcomes, and make faster, more trustworthy decisions. This is a high\-leverage role for a scientist who enjoys both deep technical work and broad cross\-functional influence—partnering with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and operators to translate cutting\-edge methods into reliable platform capabilities used across the company. **You're excited about this opportunity because you will...** ------------------------------------------------------------- * Set the scientific direction for Curie and shape the Decision Systems roadmap with engineering and product partners, identifying where better science, tooling, or automation can materially improve decision quality and velocity. * Own the statistical contract for experiment analysis, including how metrics, populations, exposure windows, covariates, ratio metrics, and edge cases are defined. * Ensure production systems faithfully implement those contracts by reviewing analytical SQL, validating statistical parity, and raising the bar for correctness across engine migrations. * Develop and productionize advanced methods such as CUPED/CUPAC, ratio\-metric and delta\-method inference, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, switchback designs, and difference\-in\-differences for marketplace interference. * Build approaches that hold up in high\-scale, high\-noise, three\-sided marketplace data, including power analysis, multiple\-testing correction, winsorization, quantile metrics, and other robust measurement techniques. * Advance AI\-assisted analysis workflows, including trustworthy automated experiment readouts, risk detection, and hypothesis generation, with the same rigor expected of statistical methods. * Advise and mentor data scientists, product teams, operators, and engineers on experimental design, metric strategy, causal analysis, and interpretation of results. **We're excited about you because you have…** --------------------------------------------- * 6\+ years of industry experience, or equivalent applied research experience, developing statistical, causal inference, machine learning, or experimentation systems with measurable business impact. * Deep expertise in experimentation and causal inference, with production experience in methods such as variance reduction, ratio metrics, sequential testing, heterogeneous treatment effects, marketplace interference, or quasi\-experimental designs. * Strong coding and data skills, including the ability to reason about production data pipelines and review complex analytical SQL for statistical correctness. * Experience translating statistical or machine learning methods into reliable, scalable platform capabilities in close partnership with engineering and product teams. * A track record of setting technical direction, influencing cross\-functional teams, and mentoring senior technical contributors without relying solely on formal authority. * The ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to scientific, engineering, product, and exec  bias for impact: you know how to balance methodological rigor, product velocity, engineering constraints, and customer needs. We expect this position to be filled by 10\-17\-2026 **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. Statement of Non\-Discrimination: In keeping with our beliefs and goals, no employee or applicant will face discrimination or harassment based on: race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, age, gender, marital/domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability status, or veteran status. Above and beyond discrimination and harassment based on "protected categories," we also strive to prevent other subtler forms of inappropriate behavior (i.e., stereotyping) from ever gaining a foothold in our office. Whether blatant or hidden, barriers to success have no place at DoorDash. We value a diverse workforce – people who identify as women, non\-binary or gender non\-conforming, LGBTQIA\+, American Indian or Native Alaskan, Black or African American, Hispanic or Latinx, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, differently\-abled, caretakers and parents, and veterans are strongly encouraged to apply. Thank you to the Level Playing Field Institute for this statement of non\-discrimination. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. **If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.** Notice to Applicants for Jobs Located in NYC or Remote Jobs Associated With Office in NYC Only We used Covey as part of our hiring and/or promotional process for jobs in NYC and certain features may qualify it as an AEDT in NYC. As part of the hiring and/or promotion process, we provided Covey with job requirements and candidate submitted applications. We began using Covey Scout for Inbound from August 21, 2023, through December 21, 2023\. We resumed using Covey Scout for Inbound again on June 29, 2024, and ceased using Covey Scout for Inbound on April 30, 2026\. The Covey tool has been reviewed by an independent auditor. Results of the audit may be viewed here:**https://getcovey.com/nyc\-local\-law\-144****.** *Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at* *Recruitment Scam Awareness \- DoorDash* *.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agentic AI New
jobs.description: **Our Why At Dotmatics** At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision\-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian. **We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.** We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best\-of\-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi\-dimensional decision\-making. Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now. **Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics** Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live. You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote\-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud\-based scientific research R\&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future. **We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.** **What do we need** We are looking for an experienced and highly skilled Software Engineer (Agentic AI), to build the AI agent at the core of Dotmatics Luma platform. You will own the agent end to end: how it reasons, which tools it uses, what it remembers, how it recovers from failure, and how we know it is working. You will work in a small, high\-trust engineering team alongside Product, scientists, and the wider Dotmatics organisation. This is also an AI\-native engineering role. Your success won’t be measured by how many lines of code you write. It will come from how well you decompose work for coding agents, give them the right context, tools, and constraints, verify their output with tests and review, and ship production software faster than a traditional senior engineer without lowering the quality bar. Coding agents are your default path for implementation, and you stay accountable for architecture, correctness, security, and review. We want someone who thinks like the engineers who build frontier AI products: rigorous about quality, curious about how agents fail, and quick to adapt as models improve. You use AI tools daily to build AI tools, and you ship agents that work in production, not just in demos. **In this role you will get to** * Develop the agent itself: the loop, harness, and control flow connecting the model, tools, and state, including subagents, long\-running tasks, checkpointing, and recovery. * Practice context engineering: decide what goes into the context window, when to compact or summarize, and how to keep the agent coherent over long\-running experiments. * Design tools for the agent, with clear interfaces and descriptions, covering instrument orchestration, scheduling, data capture, and developer tooling such as GitHub, repositories, CI/CD, and workflows. * Give the agent memory and state persistence so it learns from and builds on earlier work. * Implement permissions and sandboxing that define what the agent can do on its own, what needs human approval, and how mistakes are contained. * Defend the agent against prompt injection and untrusted content, with auditability and data isolation suited to regulated environments. * Evaluate the agent end\-to\-end on real multi\-step tasks, then debug its behavior by reading traces and finding root causes, fixing the harness, tools, or prompts to improve reliability, tool\-use accuracy, cost, and latency. * Adapt the harness as models improve, and remove scaffolding that is no longer needed. * Run an AI\-first development loop (scope, plan, delegate to coding agents, verify, ship), preferring agent execution over hand\-writing whenever quality holds, and build and maintain the team's agent harness for development itself (project memory, skills, hooks, MCP, CI checks) so agents can safely do bounded engineering work. * Measure and improve that workflow through throughput, defect rate,
