jobs.title: Systems Integration and Requirements Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** --------------------- NIRA Inc. is seeking a Systems Integration and Requirements Engineer to support Federal Aviation Administration programs involving ground\-based air traffic management and airport operational systems. Working alongside a Lead Systems Engineer, the selected candidate will translate operational needs into measurable requirements, document system interfaces, analyze real\-time performance, and develop the technical evidence needed to support integration, testing, and operational readiness. This position requires practical experience with integrated hardware, software, communications networks, field sensors or surveillance equipment, and operator\-facing systems. The successful candidate must be comfortable reviewing technical documentation, identifying inconsistencies, investigating system behavior, and developing clear engineering recommendations. This is a hands\-on engineering position focused on requirements, integration, and verification\-not an enterprise IT administration, helpdesk, or project\-coordination role. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Develop requirements and maintain traceability. Draft and refine functional, performance, interface, and supportability requirements. Maintain requirements traceability matrices linking operational needs to system requirements, design information, verification methods, and test evidence. Identify ambiguous, conflicting, missing, or untestable requirements and support their resolution. * Document and analyze system interfaces. Develop interface control documents, data\-flow diagrams, equipment/interface inventories, and integration specifications. Document communication protocols, data formats, timing and synchronization, system boundaries, and dependencies among field equipment, processing platforms, operational displays, recording functions, and external systems. * Evaluate real\-time performance and resilience. Analyze end\-to\-end latency, bandwidth, jitter, packet loss, data quality, synchronization, redundancy, and failure recovery. Review technical assumptions and supporting calculations. Assess how component or interface failures affect the required operational functions, including degraded modes and restoration. * Review technical documentation and control engineering changes. Evaluate supplier specifications, architecture documents, interface descriptions, configuration records, and test reports against the applicable requirements. Maintain technical issue logs and document the effects of proposed changes on interfaces, performance, safety, security, testing, and supportability. * Support deployment and multidisciplinary coordination. Prepare technical inputs to site\-readiness assessments, implementation plans, and transition\-to\-service documentation. Coordinate with systems engineering, operations, safety, cybersecurity, human\-factors, maintenance, and test personnel. Provide engineering assumptions and dependencies to program, cost, and schedule teams. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's degree in Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, or a closely related technical discipline, consistent with applicable contract requirements. * At least five years of relevant engineering experience, including at least three years supporting integration, requirements development, or verification of ground\-based air traffic management, airport operational systems, aviation surveillance or communications, or comparable real\-time aviation systems. * Demonstrated experience developing engineering work products, including system requirements, requirements traceability matrices, interface specifications, technical diagrams, test procedures, or verification reports. Candidates must be able to explain their personal contribution to these products. * Practical understanding of integrated operational systems that combine field equipment or sensors, network transport, processing software, and operator interfaces. Experience must extend beyond standalone application development or routine office\-network support. * Working knowledge of IP\-based communications and real\-time system performance, including TCP/UDP, network segmentation, multicast or comparable data\-distribution methods, quality of service, timing and synchronization, and redundancy. Ability to relate these concepts to operational performance and integration requirements. * Hands\-on integration and testing experience, including use of logs, packet captures, measurements, or other technical evidence to investigate issues. Experience developing or applying pass/fail criteria, documenting defects, and verifying corrective actions. * Strong technical\-writing and analytical skills, attention to configuration and version control, and the ability to manage assigned engineering tasks with limited day\-to\-day supervision. * Ability to meet applicable government background\-investigation and facility or system\-access requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Direct experience supporting FAA or National Airspace System engineering programs, including technical reviews, operational testing, site acceptance, or transition to service. * Experience with sensor\-based situational awareness, surveillance\-data processing, operational displays, or real\-time audio/video systems, including assessment of information quality, latency, synchronization, and operator\-interface behavior. * Familiarity with system\-safety, cybersecurity, human\-factors, reliability, or maintainability activities and how those disciplines affect requirements, interfaces, and verification. * Experience using requirements\-management tools, network\-analysis tools, scripting, or data\-analysis tools to maintain traceability, investigate system behavior, and summarize test results.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, GeForce G-Assist
jobs.description: At NVIDIA, we’re building GeForce G\-Assist — an on\-device AI assistant that combines Small Language Models (SLMs), retrieval systems, and hybrid cloud capabilities to deliver responsive, context\-aware assistance inside the GeForce ecosystem. We work closely across engineering and product teams to ensure G\-Assist performs reliably in real\-world scenarios. **What you'll be doing:** * Together, we focus on how models behave in production, not just on benchmarks. Evaluate and improve Small Language Models used in GeForce G\-Assist, with an emphasis on accuracy, robustness, and conversational reliability. Identify and mitigate conversation and context contamination, including state drift, prompt leakage, and retrieval cross\-talk. * Work with SLM and VLM architectures to support text and multimodal interactions. Working across scientific, clinical, and operational teams, the Principal Software Engineer establishes durable engineering practices, guides technical decisions, and mentors engineers while partnering with engineering leaders on technical approach and delivery priorities. Essential Duties and Responsibilities * Set technical direction and architecture across the software product suite, services, data systems, and integrations; align design choices with organizational needs, system constraints, and long\-term maintainability. * Lead high\-impact and ambiguous cross\-functional projects from discovery through release and production support; set the technical execution approach and manage architecture, risk, dependencies, and delivery tradeoffs. * Remain hands\-on in designing, developing, reviewing, testing, deploying, documenting, and maintaining production software, APIs, data\-processing services, scientific workflows, and operational tooling. * Lead the design and evolution of interconnected operational systems that support genomic testing from sample accessioning through laboratory and sequencing workflows, computational analysis, clinical reporting, and secure genomic\-data exchange; improve the integrations, reliability, and observability that enable those systems to operate at scale. * Work with scientific, clinical, and operational stakeholders to determine needs and establish specifications where requirements are unclear or not yet defined; translate them into scalable technical approaches and clear implementation plans; explain tradeoffs and build agreement across teams and stakeholders. * Partner with lab supervisors, clinical directors, computational biologists, Research Computing, and focused working groups to deliver dependable services and improve cross\-system workflows. * Establish and advance shared engineering practices for architecture, version control, code review, automated testing, release management, documentation, observability, data protection, and secure handling of sensitive information across related products and systems. * Guide modernization and technical\-debt work; identify opportunities to simplify systems, improve reliability and performance, and reduce operational burden through incremental, supportable changes. * Diagnose system\-wide quality, performance, capacity, integration, and production challenges; bring the right expertise together, evaluate options, and drive root\-cause solutions across system boundaries. * Mentor and coach engineers through design discussions, code reviews, and knowledge sharing; strengthen technical capability and shared practices, and support reliable delivery. When direct reports are assigned, provide regular supervision, coaching, and performance feedback. * Communicate technical options, decisions, dependencies, risks, and progress to the Software Engineering team, stakeholders, and organizational leaders; provide evidence\-based recommendations that inform technical roadmaps and shape major cross\-functional initiatives. * Use approved AI\-enabled tools, where appropriate, to support software development, testing, documentation, and troubleshooting. Validate outputs for accuracy, security, privacy, and compliance with NYGC policies before relying on them. * Guide the technical evaluation and responsible adoption of AI tools and AI\-enabled capabilities across related products and workflows, consistent with NYGC approval, security, privacy, and governance requirements. Establish practices for validation, security, privacy, compliance, reliability, and operational support. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science with 12\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, or a Master’s degree in Computer Science with 10\+ years of relevant software engineering experience. * Demonstrated success leading high\-impact, cross\-team software initiatives from problem definition and specification through delivery and ongoing production support. * Demonstrated software architecture and engineering expertise across multiple related technical areas, including sound judgment in decisions that affect interconnected systems. * Proficiency in one or more modern programming languages and object\-oriented design, and a record of delivering extensible, well\-tested, maintainabl o software workflows, including evaluating output quality, applying data\-classification requirements, and protecting against inappropriate disclosure of data. * Experience evaluating or integrating AI tools or capabilities in production systems within established approval and governance processes, including validation, security, privacy, and operational support. Collaborative \& Communicative: Builds strong relationships across functions; communicates clearly and thoughtfully; listens carefully; fosters collaboration and trust.. Adaptable \& Innovative: Embraces change, anticipates challenges, develops practical solutions, and continuously seeks opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness. Salary \& Benefits The pay range for this position is $183,000\-$214,000 per year; the base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, NYGC offers a full range of medical, financial, and other benefits as well as generous time off. This includes Medical/Dental/Vision for employees \& dependent(s); Vacation, Holidays, Sick, and Other Leave, including a paid winter break; a 401(k) match; Life Insurance; Flexible Spending Accounts; employee Tuition Reimbursement; an Employee Assistance Program; and much more. About the New York Genome Center The New York Genome Center (NYGC) is an independent, nonprofit, academic research organization dedicated to advancing genomic research. NYGC scientists and staff are furthering new approaches to diagnosing and treating neurological diseases and cancer through their unique capabilities in whole genome sequencing, RNA sequencing, state\-of\-the art analytics, and the development of genomic tools. NYGC concentrates specifically on disease\-based research in the following areas: neuropsychiatric disease (autism, schizophrenia, bipolar); neurodegenerative disease (ALS, Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, Huntington’s), and cancer. Located in Lower Manhattan, the New York Genome Center was founded by and remains closely affiliated with the leading academic medical centers and research universities in the New York region, engaging in research projects with and for these institutions. jobs.title: Senior Shopify Developer & Ecommerce Systems Administrator
jobs.description: **About ProjectorScreen.com** ProjectorScreen.com is a specialty ecommerce retailer of projectors, projection screens, and home theater products. Customers rely on us for expert guidance and an online shopping experience that helps them choose the right equipment. **The role** We're looking for an in\-house Shopify Developer \& Administrator to own the technical operation and ongoing improvement of our Shopify store. This is a hands\-on technical role combining storefront development, custom app development, store administration, database work, and ownership of our app ecosystem. You'll work directly with the owner, our Ecommerce \& Marketing Manager, sales and operations teams, and outside developers. You'll turn business needs into reliable functionality, troubleshoot problems, and make the store easier to operate. Marketing will set campaign and merchandising priorities; you'll build and maintain the technology supporting them. **What you'll own** * **Shopify development:** Develop and maintain themes, templates, sections, and custom storefront features using Liquid, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Improve product pages, collections, navigation, mobile usability, and the buying experience. * **Custom apps:** Build, deploy, and maintain custom Shopify applications and integrations. Own frontend and backend functionality, authentication, data storage, testing, monitoring, and ongoing support. * **Store administration:** Manage technical configuration for products, variants, collections, metafields, metaobjects, navigation, permissions, and store settings. Support bulk imports, catalog updates, promotions, and data quality. * **App ecosystem management:** Own the inventory, configuration, costs, permissions, and dependencies of our installed apps. Evaluate new tools, resolve conflicts, manage vendor support, and recommend when to configure an existing app, replace it, or build custom functionality. * **Search and merchandising technology:** Support the technical setup and operation of Searchspring and other search, filtering, recommendation, review, and merchandising tools. Work with marketing to implement and test the desired shopping experience. * **Integrations and automation:** Connect Shopify with HubSpot, product feeds, marketplaces, inventory, order, and fulfillment systems. Use APIs, webhooks, Shopify Flow, and other appropriate tools to reduce manual work and improve accuracy. * **Database development and administration:** Design and maintain databases supporting custom apps and integrations. Write and optimize SQL queries, manage schemas and migrations, configure access, and maintain backups and recovery procedures. * **Troubleshooting and reliability:** Diagnose storefront errors, app conflicts, slow pages, broken links, feed issues, and synchronization failures. Build useful logging, alerts, error handling, and recovery processes into custom systems. * **Testing and releases:** Use Git, development environments, and appropriate testing to release changes carefully. Maintain rollback procedures and document how the store, apps, and integrations work. * **Marketing support:** Build landing pages and promotional functionality, support tracking and technical SEO, and test the store ahead of major launches and shopping events. **Technical expertise required** * Demonstrated experience developing and administering a production Shopify store. * Strong proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Liquid, and Shopify theme development. * Experience personally building and maintaining a custom Shopify app or substantial integration in production. * Backend development experience with Node.js/TypeScript or a comparable stack, including server\-side logic, authentication, and background processing. * Strong SQL and relational database skills, including schema design, query optimization, migrations, permissions, backups, and recovery. * Experience with GraphQL, REST APIs, webhooks, and reliable data synchronization, including retries and duplicate\-event handling. * Ability to deploy, monitor, troubleshoot, and support the custom applications you build. * Experience managing third\-party apps and evaluating their effects on performance, data, cost, and operations. * Sound practices for protecting customer data, credentials, and application access. * Ability to explain technical choices clearly, prioritize by business impact, and follow projects through to completion. * Ability to work full\-time, in person in Riverdale, NJ 07457\. Experience should include writing and maintaining production code, as well as operating the store. A degree is not required. **Practical AI skills** Use Claude, ChatGPT, or comparable tools to improve development, troubleshooting, testing, documentation, and data workflows. You must understand, review, and test AI\-generated code before release. Be prepared to demonstrate a workflow you use, explain its limitations, and show how you verify its results. **Additional experience we value** * Searchspring, HubSpot integrations, Shopify Flow, and ecommerce automation. * Product information, inventory, ERP, order\-management, or fulfillment systems. * Technical SEO, structured data, GA4, conversion tracking, and marketplace feeds. * Large product catalogs, product comparison tools, and consumer electronics ecommerce. * Computer hardware, employee workstations, business software, and general IT administration. This experience is useful for diagnosing routine issues and coordinating with outside IT providers; the primary responsibility is Shopify and its connected ecommerce systems. **How to apply** Apply with your resume and brief examples of: * A Shopify store you developed or administered and what you personally owned. * A custom app or integration you built, including its database and how you supported it after launch. * An AI\-assisted workflow you use and how you check its output. Share only work you are authorized to disclose. Finalists will discuss a relevant project and a short technical scenario. We'll explain the format and expected time commitment in advance. ProjectorScreen.com is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee discount * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan Work Location: In person

Our breadth of offerings across the entire semiconductor value chain helps our customers solve their most difficult yield, device performance, quality, and reliability issues. Onto Innovation strives to optimize customers’ critical path of progress by making them smarter, faster and more efficient. **Job Summary \& Responsibilities** **About the role** ================== Onto Innovation designs and manufactures the inspection and metrology tools that the world’s leading chipmakers rely on. We believe AI will be a key enabler of faster, more reliable measurement and decision\-making in semiconductor manufacturing. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You will work closely with system engineers, algorithm developers, and applications teams to understand complex metrology workflows and data flows. You will set the vision and architecture for AI in metrology, then design, build, and productionize AI systems, including agentic ones, that speed up setup and troubleshooting and improve measurement quality. The emphasis is on agents grounded in real tools and data, with the right human oversight. You will also set technical direction and mentor the AI and ML engineers around you. **What you’ll do** ================== * **Set the vision and own the architecture.** Define the AI strategy and reference architecture for metrology, choose what to build and what to buy, and keep the roadmap tied to the problems customers actually have. * **Build it yourself.** Write, test, and ship production code — prototypes, agent workflows, evaluation tooling, and the systems that run them — and set the standard by example. * **Design agent workflows for the metrology lifecycle** — guided recipe and model setup, qualification runs, tool matching, and root\-cause triage when a measurement drifts. * **Give agents real tools.** Connect them to our simulators, solvers, and tool data so the agent orchestrates and the physics computes. * **Ground agents in fab knowledge:** retrieval manuals, recipes, service tickets, and historical measurement outcomes, with provenance on every answer. * **Design for trust.** Human\-in\-the\-loop checkpoints, confidence and uncertainty carried through every step, full audit trails, and refusal when the evidence is thin — a number without an error bar is not a measurement. * **Deploy where fabs allow it.** On\-premises and air\-gapped inference, with local or hosted models chosen on latency, cost, and data\-control constraints, and a release path that survives customer change control. * **Build the evaluation harness:** golden task sets, tool\-call correctness, agent\-built versus expert\-built recipes compared against the TMU budget, and regression tests on every model or prompt change. * **Keep the measurement science sound.** Surrogate models, parameter inference, tool calibration, and calibrated uncertainty remain the engines agents call. Own the ML behind them where it matters, including domain shift across tools, layers, and fabs. * **Lead technically.** Set standards, run design and code reviews, mentor mid\-level and junior engineers, and make the approach and build\-versus\-buy calls. Raise software quality with unit testing, test automation in CI/CD pipelines, refactoring of legacy code, and static and dynamic analysis. * **Set the practice for AI\-assisted development.** Apply AI coding tools responsibly to coding, debugging, documentation, and test generation, and maintain secure, reliable workflows for evaluating AI\-generated code: human review, automated testing, static analysis, security scanning, and validation against requirements. Spot gaps in team processes and toolchains, and drive improvements. * **Translate between fab and model.** Turn a customer’s setup or yield problem into a tractable agent workflow, then explain the result to engineers who will judge it against a reference technique. **Qualifications** **What you’ll bring** ===================== * MS or PhD in computer science, electrical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 6\+ years of applied ML/AI experience in production, including 3\+ in technical leadership, leading projects or owning the technical direction of a significant AI system. * Experience defining AI strategy and system architecture, and getting a technical vision adopted across engineering. * Hands\-on depth in LLM\-based systems: agents, tool calling, retrieval, and prompt and model evaluation, shipped to real users and monitored after release. * Strong ML foundations: deep learning in PyTorch, plus regression, anomaly sted production code every day. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools: writing clear prompts, critically reviewing generated code for errors and incorrect assumptions, and turning it into maintainable production code. * A working understanding of software security, intellectual property, data privacy, and responsible AI when using AI in enterprise software. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for complex software systems, and the ability to research and solve hard technical problems independently. * Experience developing software on Windows with Visual Studio and Azure DevOps confirm toolchain. * A record of owning AI systems in production after launch: monitoring them, diagnosing failures, and shipping updates. * Clear technical writing, and the patience to explain an AI system’s decision to a process engineer who will not accept “the model decided” as an answer. **What would make us especially interested** ============================================ * Strong programming skills in C\+\+, C\#, or CUDA where the model meets the instrument are a plus. * Semiconductor process control experience — metrology, inspection, SPC, yield analytics, or time spent in a fab. * Scatterometry or OCD, ellipsometry, reflectometry, interferometry, or e\-beam imaging. * Tool\-calling and MCP frameworks, multi\-agent orchestration, vector and hybrid search, LLM fine\-tuning, and on\-premises LLM serving. * Security and IP protection for AI systems, and shipping inside a regulated release process or with customer data that can never leave the site. * Physics\-informed ML, surrogate modeling, physics\-based modeling and numerical simulation, or Bayesian inverse methods such as MCMC or variational inference. * Parallel or high\-performance computing. * Experience in integrating AI into the software development process, such as AI\-assisted code review, automated test creation, and requirements analysis. **Working here** ================ This role is on\-site by design: it depends on close, daily collaboration with applications and system engineering. Expect regular time in the office, and occasional time at a fab or customer site. Our customers do not tolerate surprises, neither do we. Work here is reviewed, documented, and qualified before it ships — and once it does, it runs in production lines measuring wafers around the clock. Why Join Onto Innovation? At Onto Innovation, we believe your work should matter—and so should your well\-being. That’s why we offer competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family. From health, dental, and vision coverage to life and disability insurance, PTO, and a 401(k) with employer match, we’ve got you covered. You’ll also enjoy access to our Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), wellness initiatives, and cutting\-edge tools—all within a collaborative, inclusive culture where your contributions are valued and recognized. **Compensation \& Growth** * Base Salary Range: $129,600\.00 \- $194,400\.00, offered in good faith and based on experience, location, and qualifications.* Additional Rewards: Annual bonus opportunities and potential long\-term incentives tied to both company and individual success. Empowering Every Voice to Shape the Future: Onto Innovation is committed to creating a workplace where every qualified candidate has an equal opportunity to succeed. We evaluate applicants based on skills, experience, and potential \- without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We believe diversity of thought and background drives innovation and strengthens our team. Important Note on Export Compliance For certain positions requiring access to technical data, U.S. export licensing review may be necessary for applicants who are not U.S. Citizens, Permanent Residents, or other protected persons under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3\).

jobs.title: Fitness Consultant, Sales & Client Success
jobs.description: **ABOUT PALO ALTO FIT** Palo Alto Fit is Palo Alto's premier private personal training facility, home to a team of 30\+ professional coaches dedicated to delivering exceptional, individualized training, a team that will grow to 50 in the next 12 to 18 months. Our 8,000 square foot appointment\-only facility on California Avenue is designed exclusively for high\-quality one\-on\-one coaching, and we are expanding to approximately 12,000 square feet in 2026/27, every square foot of it dedicated to personal training. Our clients are professionals, families, and individuals who value expertise, privacy, and a highly personalized training experience. We are not a traditional gym. We are a professional training facility built on relationships, consistency, and long\-term client success. For more than 10 years, Palo Alto Fit has served the Palo Alto community and built a reputation for professionalism, organization, and exceptional client care, with more than 200 five\-star Google reviews to show for it. **ABOUT THE ROLE** This is one of the most critical roles in the studio. The Fitness Consultant owns every new client's first ninety days with us, and the relationship after that. You run the Free Fitness Assessment yourself: you see how a person moves, you understand their injuries, limitations and goals, and you write the handover that lets one of our thirty coaches build the right program from day one. You match them to that coach, carry them through their first weeks until training is a habit, check in with the client along the way, and work with the coach so the assessment and the program stay one plan. And you make sure every renewal happens. You sell the first package, you make every renewal happen, and you keep every client training. The first\-renewal rate and the renewal rate are the measures of your work. This is a role for someone with a Bachelor's or Master's in Kinesiology or Exercise Science who loves helping people, has real client\-facing and sales experience, wants responsibility and is ready to carry it, likes a challenge, and can hold several things at once without dropping one: an assessment at ten, a renewal to close at eleven, a coach to brief in between, and a calendar of thirty coaches, soon fifty, that has to be right every day. The instinct to solve a problem the moment it appears, rather than pass it on, is the whole job. You are not coaching sessions, and you are not sitting behind a desk waiting for the phone: you are in the assessment room with a prospective client, on the floor with a coach agreeing a client's next step, on the phone with a client who went quiet, and at the desk making sure a thirty\-coach calendar is exactly right. Every new client's outcome has your name on it, and the owners will ask you, not the coaches, how the month went. And you will work with everyone. In one day you may assess a twelve\-year\-old athlete with a parent beside them, a teenager preparing for a season, a founder between flights, a physician with forty minutes, a retired engineer coming back from surgery, and a family of four who train together. Each one needs a different conversation and the same standard of care, and you are the person who gives it to them. The problems are real and they are yours: the client who paid and never started, the standing slot that quietly ran out, the renewal that a coach has not opened, the family who shares a package and needs one clear answer. Each one has a person behind it, and each one is solved by someone who reads the situation, picks up the phone, and sees it through. The bar here is deliberately high. Everyone on this team earned their place, and that is exactly why they are proud to be here. If you are excellent at what you do, or serious about becoming excellent, you will be surrounded by people who hold the same standard. **SELL: THE FREE FITNESS ASSESSMENT AND THE FIRST PACKAGE** Be the first point of contact for prospective clients by phone, email, and in person, and the person who runs their first visit. Conduct the Free Fitness Assessment, our complimentary 45\-minute in\-person consultation and intake for every prospective client: health and training history, a movement screen, a baseline body\-composition scan, and the goal conversation. This is a consultation, not a training session, and you run it yourself. See and understand the client's limitations. An old knee, a desk\-bound back, a shoulder that will not go overhead, a nervous first\-timer: you recognize what the body in front of you can and cannot do yet, and you ask the questions that surface what they did not think to mention. Explain to each client, in plain words, what the assessment showed and how we will get them started. A hip or a knee that complains, for example: here is why, here are the muscles that need to get stronger first, and here are the exercises we begin with. They leave knowing exactly what their training will do for them. Guide each new client to the training package a leagues in the real work, including real fitness assessments, before you run your own. Real responsibility from the start, and paid for it. The first ninety days of every new client are yours, you see your first\-renewal rate every morning, you decide what to do about it, and your bonus follows the result. Warm conversations, never cold calls. Every prospective client you speak with reached out to us or booked an assessment. Your work is guiding people to the right decision, never pushing. A personal training only environment. Every person on the floor is there for a coached appointment, so the space stays calm, professional, and focused. Growing in 2026/27\. We are expanding the facility to approximately 12,000 square feet in 2026/27, all of it personal training only, and the coaching team from 30 to 50\. The person in this role grows with it. A clientele you will enjoy taking care of. Kids and teenagers, families, executives, physicians, founders, and professionals who value expertise and genuinely appreciate great care. Work directly with the founder and owner and gain first\-hand insight into operating a premier training facility. Complimentary coffee, snacks, and team amenities. **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS** Three parts: a fixed hourly rate, commission, and a bonus. Hourly compensation of $25 to $30 per hour; a commission on every first package you close at the Free Fitness Assessment; and a bonus on your first\-renewal rate when it is above our target. On\-target earnings above $100,000 a year with the three together. The commission plan is written and signed with your offer. Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees working 30 or more hours per week, with Palo Alto Fit paying 50% of your premium. Coverage starts on the first of the month once you have been with us 60 days, and you choose from four medical plans. 401(k). Complimentary facility access. Professional development opportunities. **JOB DETAILS** Hours: full time, 40 hours per week. Saturday mornings: this role includes working Saturday mornings on a rotating basis, approximately twice a month. Location: 310 S California Ave, Palo Alto, CA 94306 (in\-person). Job type: Full\-time. Learn more: www.paloaltofit.com Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $105,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Kinesiology, Exercise Science, or a closely related field, or are you in your final year? (Yes or No) * This is a full time, in\-person role at our Palo Alto studio: 40 hours a week, with Saturday mornings on a rotating basis about twice a month. Can you commit to that? (Yes or No) * Your pay here is a fixed hourly rate, commission on every first package you close, and a bonus on your first\-renewal rate, with on\-target earnings above $100,000 a year. Is pay that depends in part on your own results what you want? (Yes or No) * A new client, 52, tells you at her assessment that her right knee hurts going down stairs. In four or five sentences: what would you look at in her movement screen, which muscles would you expect to need strengthening first, and what would you tell her about how we get her started? * Write the handover note, three or four lines, that her coach would read before her first session. * A client who started six weeks ago has nothing booked and has not trained in twelve days. What do you do today, in what order, and who else do you involve? * Tell us about the last time you helped someone make a decision with money attached. What did they hesitate on, what did you say, and how did it end? * The posting names the one number you own in this role. What is it, and what would you do in your first month to move it? Please also add your LinkedIn profile link. Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Sales: 1 year (Required) Ability to Commute: * Palo Alto, CA 94306 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Sr Principal DevOps Engineer (Prisma AIRS)
jobs.description: Santa Clara, California, United States of America Product Engineering Ref ID: JR\-023415 **Our Mission** At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place. **Who We Are** In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us! We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes. **Job Summary** **Your Career** With Prisma AIRS, Palo Alto Networks is building the world's most comprehensive AI security platform. Organizations are increasingly building complex ecosystems of AI models, applications, and agents, creating dynamic new attack surfaces with risks that traditional security approaches cannot address. In response, Prisma AIRS delivers model security, posture management, AI red teaming, and runtime protection. Our customers can confidently deploy AI\-driven innovation while ensuring a formidable security posture from development through runtime. We are looking for a Senior Principal DevOps Engineer to join the Prisma AIRS shared services team. In this role you will be a technical leader whose influence extends across the entire Prisma AIRS organization. You won't just operate infrastructure; you'll build the platform that defines how we build and ship software, and you'll set the technical direction that other engineers build on. **Our Stack** Our platform is built on a modern, cloud\-native foundation centered around Kubernetes. We value deep expertise in a few core areas and a strong desire to master the technologies that drive our platform forward. * Cloud and orchestration: GCP (primary), Kubernetes, AWS, containerization tools * CI/CD and GitOps: GitLab CI, Argo CD, Argo Rollouts, GitHub Actions * Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Kubernetes Config Connector (KCC), Helm, Terraform, Cue * Languages and core tooling: Python (modern, typed), Go (highly desired), BASH, rego We actively leverage AI coding assistants like Claude to boost our productivity. * **Your Impact** * Act as a force multiplier for our engineering teams by building and evangelizing a cohesive Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that simplifies, builds safety into, and accelerates the path to production. * Drive the adoption of GitOps and progressive delivery across the organization. Leveraging the Argo suite, you will provide safe, automated, and observable deployment pipelines that engineering teams can trust, directly improving the quality and velocity of our product. * Elevate the organization's cloud\-native expertise by setting the standard for Kubernetes and GCP best practices. Your guidance and the patterns you create will directly influence the architecture, reliability, and security of our core products. * Architect and operate a highly available, secure, and scalable cloud infrastructure. Your work will form the resilient foundation that Prisma AIRS is built upon, ensuring our customers are protected around the clock. * Manage expensive GPU/TPU resource allocation, spot\-instance fleets, and cluster usage dashboards. * Reduce engineering toil and eliminate entire classes of problems through insightful automation, self\-service tooling, and observability frameworks. You will give time back to every engineer in the AIRS org. * Set the technical direction for shared platform services and drive infrastructure architecture decisions across the Prisma AIRS organization. * Mentor engineers, raise the engineering bar, and champion high standards of automation, reliability, and security across teams. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications** * 10\+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), or Cloud Platform Engineering, including designing and operating large\-scale cloud infrastructure. * Mastery of Infrastructure as Code and cloud platforms. You have extensive, hands\-on experience building and managing cloud infrastructure declaratively. You are an expert in modern IaC tools (Terraform, Helm, Crossplane/ACK/KCC) and have deep proficiency with a major cloud provider, ideally GCP. * Deep expertise in the cloud\-native ecosystem. You have a thorough understanding of Kubernetes in large\-scale production environments and are fluent in building automation and platform tooling using modern, typed Python. * Extensive production experience with GitOps and CI/CD: Argo CD and Argo Rollouts for continuous delivery and progressive rollout, and GitLab CI for automating complex software delivery pipelines. * Hands on with infrastructure: doesn't just use infrastructure or manage infrastructure via applications, but builds infrastructure. Examples: cloud\-native, kubernetes\-native, builds internal developer platforms, builds terraform providers. * A superpower for debugging. When things break, you are the person people turn to. You have a deep command of engineering fundamentals — from Linux internals and networking to application performance — that allows you to systematically diagnose and solve problems in complex distributed systems, regardless of the specific technology stack. An innate sense of ownership and a collaborative spirit. You are a highly technical, self\-motivated contributor who sees projects through from idea to production. Crucially, you are easy to work with and excel at navigating the organization, acting as a central point of collaboration for multiple engineering teams. * **Preferred Qualifications** * MLOps experience operating GPU\-accelerated inference and model\-serving infrastructure at scale (Google Vertex AI, Amazon Bedrock, NVIDIA Triton Inference Server). * Advanced MLOps: data/feature pipelines, model serving (KServe/Seldon), ML security and governance, and LLMOps (RAG, eval, guardrails). * Languages and core tooling: Python (modern, typed), Go (highly desired), BASH, rego. * Cloud\-native monitoring and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, GCP Cloud Monitoring). * Cloud security compliance, IAM controls, and securing container workloads. * Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, etc.). * BS/MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. \#LI\-TD1 **Compensation Disclosure** The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non\-sales roles) or base salary \+ commission target (for sales/com\-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. $177,500\.00 \- $287,100\.00/yr **Our Commitment** We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship?: Yes

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff (Software Engineer, Enterprise Trust & Governance)
jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ The Enterprise Trust \& Governance team builds the control plane that lets the world’s largest organizations deploy Perplexity broadly and with confidence. Computer and our agents work across a growing share of our customers’ environments, tools, and models. For administrators, that makes precise, enforceable control essential: who can do what, with which data, through which agents, and within what usage limits. This team makes those controls easy to manage, reliable and consistent across every product, and transparent to the people accountable for them. This is a product and platform engineering role with end\-to\-end ownership, from shaping the architecture and policy models to shipping the experiences our customers’ administrators and security teams use every day. You’ll work across product and infrastructure teams to turn complex enterprise requirements into reusable primitives and intuitive controls. The scope spans identity and provisioning, fine\-grained role\-based access across connectors, tool actions, and models, customer\-managed encryption keys, admin APIs, audit logs, and policy and usage controls. Strong governance helps enterprises move from pilots to company\-wide rollouts and gives them the confidence to entrust agents with greater responsibility over time. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own enterprise identity and provisioning, including SSO (SAML/OIDC), SCIM, WorkOS integrations, and support for identity providers such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID. * Build the permissions platform, with fine\-grained roles and permissions for connectors, tool actions, models, and model effort levels, enforced consistently across products and agent workflows. * Design and ship secure, well\-documented admin APIs for audit logs, members, groups, roles, and settings. * Build policy controls for model and feature availability, staged rollouts, model deprecations, usage and spend limits, alerts, and cost\-center allocation. * Build admin\-facing analytics for adoption, usage, spend, and policy enforcement, helping organizations measure value and manage their deployments. * Deliver audit logs and change notifications that help administrators investigate activity, track configuration changes, and support compliance. * Set the technical bar for authorization correctness and reliability, with fast, consistent, explainable permission checks, well\-defined failure behavior, and strong tenant isolation. * Partner with Product, Design, Security, Sales, and Customer Success to translate complex enterprise requirements into reusable platform capabilities and intuitive admin experiences. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 4\+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex backend systems from design through production operation. * Strong system design skills, including building reliable, scalable, multi\-tenant SaaS platforms with clear security and isolation boundaries. * Strong proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust, and hands\-on experience with cloud infrastructure such as AWS and Kubernetes. * Deep expertise in at least one of the following: + Enterprise identity and provisioning, including OAuth, OIDC, SAML, and SCIM. + Permissions platforms, fine\-grained authorization, and policy enforcement. + Encryption, customer\-managed keys, and key lifecycle management. + Enterprise admin platforms, audit infrastructure, or usage and spend analytics. * Experience building or integrating enterprise identity and access systems, including platforms such as WorkOS, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID. * Sound technical judgment in security\-sensitive systems, balancing threat models, authorization correctness, and failure behavior with usability and delivery speed. * A track record of leading ambiguous, cross\-team initiatives from architecture through adoption, setting technical direction for shared platforms, and raising engineering quality through mentorship. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every qualification. We value demonstrated impact, deep ownership, and the initiative to turn ambiguity into results.

jobs.title: Embedded Real Time Operating System Staff Software Engineer (QuRT OS, Zephyr)
jobs.description: **Company:** ------------ Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. **Job Area:** ------------- Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> DSP Architecture and Design **General Summary:** **General Summary** Qualcomm is seeking a Staff Embedded Software Engineer (6\+ years of experience) to join the Core Platform Kernel software team. The Core Platform Kernel team develops and deploys real\-time operating system (RTOS) software across multiple subsystems on Qualcomm SoCs, servicing Mobile Handset, XR, Compute, Automotive, Cloud AI, and IoT market segments. The team is responsible for the deployment and evolution of two RTOS platforms at scale: QuRT OS and Zephyr RTOS. As part of Qualcomm's continued investment in open source software, this role will help drive our Zephyr strategy and serve as a technical leader for Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr ecosystem. We are specifically seeking engineers who can contribute to and help maintain upstream Zephyr components while enabling Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm products. This role is well suited for engineers who enjoy deep technical work, influence system architecture, collaborate across organizational boundaries, and have a passion for building software that benefits both Qualcomm products and the broader open\-source community. What You'll Do As a Staff Engineer, you will: * Design, implement, and maintain RTOS and low\-level system software components. * Own and drive resolution of complex system\-level issues involving performance, stability, scalability, and correctness. * Lead feature development from problem definition through deployment. * Analyze crash dumps, traces, and logs to perform deep root\-cause analysis. * Collaborate closely with hardware, systems, validation, and software teams to deliver robust solutions. * Participate actively in design and code reviews, influencing technical direction and engineering standards. * Drive Qualcomm's engagement with the Zephyr open\-source community through technical discussions, code reviews, and upstream collaboration. * Mentor engineers on upstream development practices, code quality, and community engagement. Influence technical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and software quality initiatives across the organization. * You will be expected to take ownership of key technical areas, make sound engineering tradeoffs, and help raise the effectiveness of the broader team through technical leadership and example. QuRT OS QuRT OS is Qualcomm's real\-time operating system optimized for the Hexagon DSP, enabling high\-performance, low\-power workloads including edge AI, modem processing, audio, sensor processing, and other specialized compute workloads. In the QuRT OS space, you will: * Drive enhancements to expose the full capability of the Hexagon processor architecture. * Design and implement new RTOS features with attention to correctness, performance, and maintainability. * Own features end\-to\-end: requirements, architecture, implementation, testing, documentation, integration, and support. Improve CI, automation, and test infrastructure to increase development velocity and software quality. * Zephyr RTOS The Core Platform Kernel team is a major adopter of Zephyr RTOS across Qualcomm SoCs and subsystems. We maintain a scalable Zephyr platform while contributing improvements back to the upstream community. This role is focused on technical leadership, stewardship, and upstream engineering within the Zephyr ecosystem. Successful candidates will possess a strong understanding of RTOS architecture, embedded systems, and open\-source development practices. In the Zephyr space, you will: * Serve as a maintainer or technical owner for key Zephyr subsystems, drivers, platform infrastructure, or architecture components. * Review, guide, and integrate contributions from both internal and external developers. * Design and implement new Zephyr capabilities with an emphasis on upstream acceptance and long\-term maintainability. * Lead architecture discussions and influence technical direction within the Zephyr project. * Drive Qualcomm's upstream contribution strategy and ensure internal development aligns with community best practices. * Collaborate with maintainers and contributors from other companies across the Zephyr ecosystem. * Enable Zephyr deployment across Qualcomm platforms through board support packages, architecture enablement, driver development, and system software integration. * Improve testing, CI infrastructure, release readiness, and software quality across upstream and Qualcomm\-maintained components. * Represent Qualcomm in technical working groups, design reviews, and community discussions. Help shape the future evolution of Zephyr through upstream contributions, reviews, and technical leadership. * **How You Work (Tools, Automation \& Modern Engineering)** Staff Engineers at Qualcomm are expected to be force multipliers, not just individual contributors. In practice, this means: * Applying modern develop ence collaborating across company boundaries in community\-driven software development environments. * **Why This Team** This team builds foundational RTOS software deployed across a broad range of Qualcomm products and markets. We work close to the hardware, solve difficult system\-level problems, and influence both platform architecture and engineering practices. Qualcomm is making a long\-term investment in Zephyr RTOS as a strategic platform across multiple product lines. This role provides a unique opportunity to shape both Qualcomm's internal RTOS strategy and the future direction of one of the industry's most important open\-source embedded operating systems. The team values analytical thinking, technical excellence, collaboration, clear communication, and continuous improvement. Staff Engineers are expected to lead through technical expertise, mentor others, influence architecture decisions, and help deliver high\-quality software at scale while remaining deeply hands\-on with the code. If you are passionate about RTOS development, open\-source software, and helping shape the future of Zephyr, we'd love to hear from you. Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries). **To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies** : Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. jobs.description: Experience level: Mid\-senior Experience required: 6 Years Education level: Bachelor’s degree Job function: Engineering Industry: Real Estate Total position: 1 Relocation assistance: No Visa sponsorship eligibility: No **About the Role** The Civil Engineer oversees and expedites commercial, residential, and mixed\-use land development projects from conception to completion. Continually seeks to expedite projects and improve efficiency while maintaining established project standards. Prepares land development budgets, budget revisions, maintains compliance, and provides exception reporting. Develops and maintains project schedules and is responsible for achieving company objectives. **Key Responsibilities** Leads and supports the design and execution of land development projects from concept through completion. Develops, monitors, and manages detailed project schedules and reports, from project inception through design, entitlement, permitting, construction and bond release. Develops, monitors, and manages detailed cost projections, budgets, resource management plans, change orders, and plan changes with contractors and consultants, ensuring projects stay on schedule, within budget, and meet quality expectations. Evaluates the cost, schedule, and constructability impacts of design revisions and scope changes; coordinates with contractors to develop and negotiate change orders; updates project budgets and forecasts; and communicates approved revisions to external engineers, architects, surveyors, and other third\-party consultants to ensure all project teams are working from the latest approved plans and project requirements. Coordinates with internal teams, consultants, contractors, and public agencies to ensure projects remain on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with all regulatory requirements. Review and approve invoices, change orders, and payment applications. Oversees site plan development, grading, stormwater management systems, utility and infrastructure designs in coordination with the Construction Engineer. Prepares Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and manages the competitive bidding process for consultants, contractors, and vendors. Reviews and compares proposals for completeness, technical qualifications, project approach, pricing, and schedule; identifies scope gaps and cost variances; negotiates where appropriate; and presents bid evaluations and award recommendations to the Executive Vice President for approval. Coordinates contract execution following award. Manages relationships with consultants, general contractors, subcontractors, inspectors, utilities, public agencies, and regulatory bodies to keep land development work progressing efficiently. Reviews and interprets construction drawings, specifications, and documents to confirm alignment with project goals. Amends plans as necessary to accommodate changes to expedite bond release. Partners with the Field Operations Project Manager to facilitate the transition from design to construction by coordinating project schedules, construction logistics, contractor activities, design clarifications, and field modifications. Ensures project changes are communicated effectively and incorporated into budgets, schedules, and contract documents. Manages the implementation and administration of development proffers throughout the project lifecycle. Coordinates with civil engineers, land use attorneys, consultants, and Loudoun County staff to ensure all applicable proffer obligations are accurately incorporated into site plans, construction documents, and project schedules. Develops and maintains comprehensive proffer tracking logs, monitors compliance milestones, coordinates the completion of required improvements and contributions, and prepares, assembles, and submits supporting documentation to the County to demonstrate satisfaction of proffer obligations and facilitate formal proffer release or acceptance. Regularly visit job sites, monitor progress, and in coordination with the Construction Engineer, quickly address any construction challenges that arise. In coordination with the Field Operations Project Manager, receives and facilitates timely responses to project concerns raised by owners, residents, tenants, builders, agencies, and association representatives. Establishes and upholds quality control standards across all projects. Ensures all work complies with local building codes, safety standards, and company guidelines. **What We Are Looking For** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering and a Professional Engineer (PE) license in Virginia (or the ability to obtain reciprocity within 6 months). 7\+ years of experience overseeing land development for commercial, residential, and mixed\-use construction projects. Strong ability to read, interpret, and amend construction drawings, specifications, and contracts. Experience with construction management and scheduling tools such as Procore, Bluebeam, or Primavera. Exceptional communication, analytical problem\-solving, and leadership abilities, with a proven track record of keeping cross\-functional teams aligned and on target. **Preferred:** OSHA 30 certification. **Work Environment \& Physical Demands** This role features a dynamic mix of office work and active site visits. Regular field work requires walking uneven terrain, climbing stairs, and working outdoors in various weather conditions while wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as hard hats, safety glasses, and steel\-toed boots. Ability to lift/carry light to moderate loads (up to 20–30 lbs) such as plans, laptops, and safety gear. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brambleton, VA 20148

jobs.title: SEO & AI Search Lead
jobs.description: StatBid is an operator\-led e\-commerce growth agency. We pair hands\-on services with our own software to help Shopify merchants grow profitably. We've run online retail businesses ourselves. We help clients find what's holding growth back and spend their marketing money well. Sometimes the problem sits outside of search, and spending more won't fix it. We'd rather earn trust over time than push for a quick sale. We're about 30 people working across more than 14 countries. We run the company democratically, with open books. As a Certified B Corporation™, we're accountable for our impact on clients, our team, the community and the environment. We're working toward a vision of sustainable commerce, and one of the things we find most rewarding is collaborating with people from different backgrounds and parts of the world to make a meaningful difference. The opportunity We're looking for an experienced e\-commerce SEO practitioner to lead our organic search practice and help us build what comes next. We've developed a 6\-Pillar SEO Framework grounded in years of hands\-on experience operating online retail businesses. It gives us a common approach to technical SEO, content, rankings, reporting, competitive intelligence and client\-specific projects. The framework is still early in its development. We need to better understand the quality of the work it produces, the value it creates for merchants, and where we can improve it. We're looking for someone who can help us answer those questions and turn what we learn into better ways of working. Today, we support about 20 e\-commerce sites. Our ambition is to build a system that can serve hundreds of merchants without growing our team at the same rate. That only works if we're consistently creating value for the merchants we serve. We're also seeing consumer shopping behavior change as AI becomes part of how people discover, evaluate and buy products. Much of what makes good SEO still matters, but there are new techniques to develop, test and improve. We want someone who's passionate about e\-commerce and excited to help us figure out what organic search and agentic commerce will look like in the years ahead. You'll be our most senior SEO practitioner and the primary SEO expert our clients work with. You'll guide the team, solve difficult problems, help improve our software and take responsibility for the quality and effectiveness of our organic search work. You'll have a team and a framework to build on, but plenty of freedom to question how things are done. What you'll do **Lead our organic search work.** Work with our e\-commerce strategists and SEO team to develop client roadmaps, set priorities and make sure the work produces meaningful results. You'll be the person we turn to when SEO decisions require experienced technical judgment. **Solve complex e\-commerce SEO problems.** Get hands\-on with technical audits, site architecture, crawling and indexing, structured data, redirects, platform migrations, product catalogs and other challenges that come with running large e\-commerce sites. You won't do all the work yourself, but you'll need the skills to step in when necessary. **Work directly with clients.** Be the primary SEO expert our clients interact with through monthly Zoom meetings, email, Slack and other conversations. Help them understand what we're doing, why it matters, what the results tell us and what we recommend next. **Help win new business.** Participate in sales conversations, conduct SEO audits for prospective clients, identify opportunities and explain how StatBid can help. Your technical expertise and ability to connect recommendations to business outcomes will be important to earning clients' trust. **Improve the framework.** Help us establish and measure first\-time quality, understand where the work creates merchant value and identify where our approach falls short. Use what we learn to improve the framework, our standards and how we deliver SEO. Nothing about the framework is off\-limits to questioning. **Help build better tools.** Our proprietary software, Argos, is becoming an increasingly important part of how our team and AI agents identify, prioritize and execute work. You'll be an important source of feedback, helping define new functionality, improve recommendations and translate SEO expertise into repeatable processes and agent skills. You'll work closely with our engineering and data teams to make that happen. **Explore organic and agentic commerce.** Keep learning as search and shopping behavior evolve. Develop hypotheses, test new approaches and help us understand what actually improves merchant visibility and results across traditional search and emerging AI platforms. **Help others do better work.** Coach team members, review the quality of their work, share your expertise and help improve our standards. Our SEO support team has its own manager, so this isn't primarily a people management role. Your influence will come thro s you've been doing it. Here's what matters most to us: * **Strong e\-commerce SEO expertise.** You understand technical SEO, content strategy, site architecture, crawling and indexing, structured data, redirects, migrations and the other challenges involved in growing organic traffic and revenue for online retailers. You can both diagnose problems and help implement solutions. * **Experience with Shopify.** Shopify is central to our work, so strong experience with the platform is highly desirable. We'd consider someone exceptional from another e\-commerce platform who can demonstrate an ability to get up to speed quickly. * **An understanding of how online retail works.** You recognize that rankings and traffic aren't the ultimate goal. You can connect SEO decisions to merchandising, inventory, conversion, revenue and profitability. Experience working inside an e\-commerce business is especially valuable, but not required. * **Good judgment and ownership.** You can distinguish important problems from distractions, set priorities and take responsibility for outcomes. When something isn't working, you find out why and do something about it. * **A willingness to build systems.** You enjoy figuring out how to make good work repeatable. You look for opportunities to improve processes, eliminate unnecessary work and use technology to make the team more effective. You don't need to have built a system like ours before. * **Curiosity and adaptability.** You're passionate about e\-commerce, organic search and emerging agentic commerce channels. You actively learn new technologies, test ideas and change your approach when the evidence suggests something better. * **Clear communication.** You can explain complicated technical subjects in language clients understand, make recommendations confidently and have difficult conversations when needed. * **A collaborative approach.** You enjoy working with others, sharing what you know and helping people develop. Previous coaching experience is a plus, but genuinely caring about others and their growth matters more. jobs.description: **Job Description:** Thomson Reuters is hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the core of the document\-processing platform behind our AI products. The platform turns very large volumes of documents, millions of pages a day, into clean, structured output through a queue\-driven pipeline. It powers flagship products like Westlaw and CoCounsel and serves internal product teams across the company. The work is mostly Rust in DU Core, with regular work in the C\#/.NET services (DU Apps) that sit in front of it. As a Senior Software Engineer II, you’ll lead high\-impact projects across Core and Apps, shape how the platform evolves, and set the technical bar for the team. **Key Responsibilities:** * Turn asks into requirements. Take requirements from product owners and consuming teams, and propose your own improvements. Turn them into clear functional and technical requirements: the problem, who is asking, how much traffic it affects, acceptance criteria, non\-goals, and how we’ll know it worked * Design with explicit trade\-offs. Write design docs and ADRs that include all the options considered and why the chosen solution won out. Cover cost, latency, quality, failure modes, operability and security, not just the happy path. * Define the architecture. Shape how our services are designed, deployed and run on Azure, and decide where the boundaries between services belong. * Find and fix bottlenecks. Use production metrics, profiling, latency distributions and traffic mix to find where the pipeline is slow or wasteful, and to set timeouts, limits, concurrency and rollout plans. Back decisions with benchmarks and load tests, and be clear about what the results do and don’t show. * Build and run the processing pipeline end to end. It’s a queue\-driven pipeline that handles millions of pages per day. That means autoscaling, rate limiting, retries and failover across third\-party vendors, very large inputs, and streaming with bounded memory while minimizing latency and maximizing throughput. * Work across Core and Apps. You’ll likely spend most of your time in the core backend Rust services, but be willing to pivot to C\#/.NET to support the customer\-facing services that sit in front of them. * Evolve contracts safely. Change message schemas, API surfaces and feature flags across services, and often across repos, in one coordinated change. Internal product teams depend on our output, so keep changes additive and backward compatible, ship with a rollout and rollback plan that covers every side, and return errors that consumers can act on. * Keep a strong engineering mindset. Prefer simple designs over convoluted ones, deliver in small reviewable steps, test at the right layers, and leave code better than you found it. * Work agentically. Write specs and plans that coding agents can carry out, break work into reviewable pieces, and check agent output with tests and evidence. Evaluate AI tools for specific use cases. You own the correctness every line you merge, whoever or whatever wrote it. * Improve how humans and agents work here. Evolve our agent instructions, skills and review automation so they capture what the team knows, and measure whether they help. Write code, docs and PRs clear enough that a new teammate and an AI agent can both understand the intent, constraints and invariants. * Own it in production. Instrument services so you can see how they behave, take part in the on\-call rotation and incident response, write blameless postmortems, and turn what you learn into lasting fixes. * Lead high\-impact work. Own the design and rollout of large projects from requirements through production, break * them into pieces the team can deliver, and keep the vision for where they’re headed. * Raise the team’s bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard in code and design review. Influence direction. Translate business needs into technical solutions, explain hard trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences, and shape product and platform decisions with consuming teams and leadership * **Required Qualifications:** * 7\+ years of professional software development experience building and operating backend services in production in Rust or C\+\+. If your background is C\+\+, you should be keen to work in Rust day to day. * Experience leading complex projects across teams, including architecture for multi\-region or highly available systems. * Experience designing features with privacy and compliance requirements in mind, and building those requirements into code. * Deep distributed\-systems expertise: message queues and at\-least\-once delivery, idempotency, backpressure, retries and timeouts, failure detection, and autoscaling. * Experience choosing between storage options (relational, NoSQL and others) for a given workload. * A record of performance work at scale: profiling, benchmarking, memory budgets, concurrency limits, and handling inputs that don’t fit in memory * A track record of written design work (d catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world. jobs.title: Data Pipeline Engineer — Apache Airflow (Astronomer) & Python
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ Triade is a data and analytics consultancy working across the United States, Brazil and Mexico. We are adding two **data pipeline engineers** to a large pipeline build\-and\-migrate programme for a financial\-services client, delivered through our platform partner. This is a hands\-on build role. You will create data pipelines in **Python and PySpark**, author and operate Airflow DAGs, and take them all the way to production — not design slides about them. The volume is substantial, so we are looking for people who have run pipelines at scale and know what breaks. **A controlled banking environment — please read before applying** ------------------------------------------------------------------ All work is done inside the client's **highly controlled and monitored banking environment**. These rules are not negotiable: * **No AI\-assisted development.** AI coding assistants and generative AI tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT or similar) may not be used for any work on this engagement. You write the code yourself. * **No copy and paste** into or out of the environment. * **No file upload or download** — nothing leaves or enters the environment except through the client's approved channels. * **Activity is monitored.** Sessions and actions in the environment are logged and reviewed. A breach of these rules can end the engagement immediately, damage your professional reputation and Triade's, and expose the people involved to legal action. If you cannot work this way, this role is not for you. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Create ETL/ELT pipelines in Python and PySpark** — ingestion, transformation, orchestration, retries, idempotency, backfills. * **Author and operate Apache Airflow DAGs** — dependencies, sensors, dynamic task mapping, SLAs, alerting. Keep a daily chain running when one task fails. * **Deploy to production** — CI/CD, code review, environment promotion, release discipline in a controlled, audited environment. * **Migrate and implement at volume** — a large backlog of jobs to stand up; repeatability and patterns matter more than bespoke cleverness. * **Own operational quality** — monitoring, logging, cost and runtime, incident response on your own pipelines. * **Communicate in writing, in English** — pull requests, runbooks, status to the client. **What you need** ----------------- * **Expert\-level Apache Airflow in production.** Not coursework, not "exposure" — you have owned DAGs that other people depended on. * **Strong Python and PySpark for data engineering** — clean, tested, reviewed code, **written without AI assistance**. * **You have deployed to production yourself**, through CI/CD, in an environment with change control. * **SQL** and comfort with warehouse/lakehouse patterns. * **Comfort working under strict security controls** — no AI tools, no copy and paste, no file transfer, monitored sessions. * **English at a working professional level.** You will write for and speak to a financial services client. This one is not negotiable. * **Available to start in early November** and to work United States business hours. There is no extended ramp on this engagement. **Nice to have** ---------------- * **Astronomer / Astro** specifically — managed Airflow, Astro CLI, deployment workflows. * Astronomer or Apache Airflow certification. * **Starburst, Trino, Iceberg**, or similar federated query and lakehouse technology. * Financial services or another regulated environment — ideally inside a bank's controlled environment. * dbt, Kafka; AWS, Azure or GCP. * Experience on a large migration rather than greenfield only. **How we work** --------------- * Fully remote, United States business hours. * Written status over verbal — a decision that is not written down did not happen. * You work alongside data architects and platform engineers, and with partner delivery teams. **Details** ----------- Independent contractor through Triade LLC, paid in US dollars, 6 to 12 months, hourly, extendable. **Tell us your expected hourly rate and currency when you apply.** Triade is an equal opportunity company. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Location Remote Type Remote Contract Contract Published 10/18/2026

jobs.description: Research Associate (5245C) \- Civil \& Environmental Engineering About Berkeley At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive.
