At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups. We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence. Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride . Departmental Overview The Civil \& Environmental Engineering Department at the University of California, Berkeley has a position opening for a Research Associate. The individual will be based in\-person at UC Berkeley and will be part of the GeoSystems Engineering Faculty and Staff working under the direction of Professor Dimitrios Zekkos. The individual will be funded through a National Science Foundation (NSF) grant to support the Geotechnical Extreme Events Reconnaissance Association (GEER), which is currently led by Prof. Zekkos at UC Berkeley, Prof. Nina Stark at the University of Florida and Prof. Brady Cox at Utah State University. The College of Engineering at UC Berkeley is recognized for its educational and research excellence, consistently ranking among the top three engineering schools in the country. The Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering (CEE) is one of the most prestigious academic departments within the College and on campus. US News and World Report has, for many years, ranked CEEs graduate program in civil engineering \#1 in the nation. CEE offers a rigorous academic education that prepares students for leadership in the profession of civil and environmental engineering. The Geosystems program is part of the CEE Department and has a very long and distinguished legacy in geotechnical engineering. Geosystems faculty, students, and researchers have been pioneers in research directions that have shaped the geotechnical engineering profession. The Geotechnical Extreme Events Reconnaissance (GEER) Association is recognized internationally as a premier organization in extreme event investigation. Supported by the NSF, GEER brings together a global network of geotechnical engineers, engineering geologists, and earth scientists to collect perishable data during extreme events with geotechnical engineering impacts. GEER is widely regarded as the principal entity for collecting critical field data following earthquakes, tsunamis, storms, and other ground failures. Through its reconnaissance missions, GEER offers hands\-on field experience and training that prepares professionals for leadership in disaster response and hazard mitigation. GEER has a legacy of continuously pioneering advanced technologies and protocols that have shaped the profession and enhanced community resilience. Position Summary The Research Associate is responsible for managing Geotechnical Extreme Event Reconnaissance Association (GEER) communications, operations, deployments, education and outreach and data archiving activities. This position coordinates the engagement of stakeholders in critical areas even before the occurrence of an event, manages virtual communications during reconnaissance, and facilitates collaborations with NHERI DesignSafe, NHERI Rapid and other partners. The Research Associate supports coordination with the science advisory groups (SAGs), virtual reconnaissance teams, and field deployment teams to ensure efficient data collection, indexing and communication of findings to advance hazard science. Additionally, this position assists with hosting virtual and in\-person GEER events, outputs, communications and training. Application Review Date **The First Review Date for this job is:** October 30, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date. Responsibilities Extreme Event Response \- 30% Support GEERs response during and after the extreme events that include; Earthquakes, Landslides \& Ground Failures, Hurricanes \& Typhoons, Floods \& Extreme Storms, Wildfires, etc. Provide administrative and technical support using established procedures during the response (virtual and in\-person) with an emphasis on ensuring that perishable data is made available through GEER an ommunity. Assist the reconnaissance team in creating such datasets as necessary. Outreach and Communication Strategy \- 30% Lead the outreach and communication strategy of GEER with a focus on engaging the scientific community, engaging with GEER stakeholders, and communicating GEER findings. This includes operating the website, the newsletter and supporting the organization of GEER events to communicate the impact of GEER. Data Management Protocols \- 5% Assists in developing protocols for data management and curation activities with a focus on AI\-ready datasets. This includes protocols for data collection and data archiving in NHERI Designsafe. Field Equipment and Deployment \- 5% Maintain field equipment and deploy as part of a GEER extreme events response team to areas affected by extreme events. Receive training and potentially deploy to disasteraffected areas with specialty equipment. Participate in reconnaissance studies and assist with data collection, particularly using equipment for which training will be provided. Required Qualifications **Technical background to one of the following areas:** field data acquisition, sensing (sensors, remote sensing), geospatial data analysis of optical, multi\-spectral and radar imagery, or disaster data analysis using programming and AI. Minimum of three (3\) years of professional or research experience collecting, processing and analyzing geotechnical and/or geospatial data, preferably within a university research, government, or non\-profit environment. Demonstrated experience with project management and data management practices. Experience with field work for geotechnical characterization under difficult conditions. Ability to foster collaborative relationships and provide essential support to research teams. Excellent writing and oral communication skills. Demonstrated experience with field data analysis. Demonstrated experience with design and implementation of computational tools such as AI, machine vision, remote sensing data analysis. Demonstrated experience with geospatial data analysis, field geodetic data collection (i.e. LiDAR, UAS, GPS, TLS). Demonstrated experience with cyberinfrastructure development lifecycle for processing and managing complex, high\-volume geospatial data with open\-data principles. Preferred Qualifications Demonstrated experience leading and coordinating field teams in complex and challenging environments. Two to five (2\-5\) years post\-PhD research experience collecting, processing and analyzing geotechnical and/or geospatial data. Experience working with or in the hazards community (e.g., emergency management, geoscience, climate resilience). Education / Training Master's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training (Preferred) PhD in geotechnical engineering or geosciences or engineering (Preferred) Salary \& Benefits For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation \& Benefits website. Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience. The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $31\.68 to $43\.09 hourly. This is a non\-exempt, bi\-weekly paid position. This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) Career position eligible for UC benefits.

The central challenge is making the complete construction system work: coordinating machine motion, concrete behavior, structural requirements, utilities integration, manufacturing, and field operations within a practical cost and schedule. A strong candidate will have deep engineering experience and be able to contribute to engineering objectives on the ground while also setting long\-term technical directives. **What You'll Do** * Own the integrated engineering roadmap, technical milestones, and execution plan for Verustruct’s robotic construction platform. * Translate product and deployment goals into measurable system requirements, subsystem interfaces, engineering priorities, and verification criteria. * Lead architecture and trade studies across disciplines, balancing performance, reliability, safety, manufacturability, cost, serviceability, and development speed. * Establish clear technical ownership and decision\-making across teams and resolve dependencies before they become integration bottlenecks. * Remain directly involved in critical design work, technical reviews, experiments, and failure investigations. * Build an integration and test strategy that connects component validation, subsystem testing, complete\-machine operation, and construction\-site performance. * Coordinate robotics development with materials processing, structural engineering, and construction requirements so the machine and the building system develop together. * Identify the highest\-risk assumptions and organize focused analysis, prototypes, and tests to resolve them early. * Lead engineering planning and resource allocation, communicate schedule and technical risks clearly, and make explicit tradeoffs as priorities evolve. * Recruit, mentor, and manage engineers and technical leads; provide direct feedback and establish a high standard for technical judgment and execution. * Develop practical standards for design reviews, configuration control, documentation, release strong teammates, and setting clear expectations. * Strong systems\-engineering judgment, including requirements definition, interface management, verification planning, and disciplined handling of technical risk. * Ability to distinguish problems that need rigorous analysis from those best resolved with a fast, well\-designed experiment. * Experience making resource and schedule tradeoffs in an environment with incomplete information and evolving requirements. * Clear communication with technical teams, company leadership, and external partners. * A degree in engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. **Benefits** ------------ Benefits include: * **Health insurance:** Silver PPO plan, 80% company\-paid, with optional dental and vision coverage * ReCon owns Virta's quote\-to\-cash path end to end: how customer contracts and pricing are configured, how clinical events become billable episodes of care, how subscriptions and invoices are generated, how claims reach payors, and how we prove all of it reconciles across commercial, billing, and our clinical data. Expand the assertion and reconciliation framework that catches discrepancies across Salesforce, Zuora, and our clinical data before they ever reach a customer invoice. * Improve the reconciliation and billing data our health plan and employer partners depend on — not just to pay us, but to bill their own clients. * Design self\-service tools so finance, RCM, and client operations can configure contracts, correct data, and run bulk changes without an engineer in the loop. * Apply AI where it earns its place. * Raise the bar around you through design and code review, and mentor engineers on the team. **90 Day Plan** =============== Within your first 90 days at Virta, we expect you will do the following: * First 30 days: Production PR merged and deployed; can whiteboard the money path unprompted; has independently found at least one thing that's wrong. * 60 days: A TDD survived architecture review; Stakeholders start to recognize you and work on building a future\-looking feature/project with you. * 90 days: Owns an ambiguous problem and proceeds towards completion with a product mindset; another engineer’s design got better because of your review. **Must\-Haves** =============== * 5\+ years building and operating backend services in production, in Go or another statically typed language * Experience with event\-driven architectures and the failure modes that come with them — eventual consistency, ordering, idempotency, and systems that disagree with each other * Strong SQL, and comfort working across both application code and the analytics layer * You've owned a system where correctness had consequences outside the company — billing, payments, claims, ledgers, or regulated reporting * A track record of working directly with non\-engineering stakeholders: turning a finance or operations problem into a design, and explaining the tradeoffs back * Experience with a major cloud platform (we use GCP) * Working with AI to accelerate development workflows and enhance the SDLC * Experience in frontend development with React and Typescript. **Values\-driven culture** ========================== Virta’s company values drive our culture, so you’ll do well if: * You put **people first** and take care of yourself, your peers, and our patients equally * You have a strong sense of **ownership** and take initiative while empowering others to do the same * You prioritize positive **impact** over busy work * You have **no ego** and understand that everyone has something to bring to the table regardless of experience * You appreciate **transparency** and promote trust and empowerment through open access of information * You are **evidence\-based** and prioritize data and science over seniority or dogma * You **take risks and rapidly iterate** Is this role not quite what you're looking for? Join our Talent Community and follow us on Linkedin to stay connected! *Virta has a location based compensation structure. Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications \& experience. For this role, the compensation range is 161,500 \- 232,500\. Information about Virta’s benefits is on our Careers page at:* *https://www.virtahealth.com/careers**.* *As part of your duties at Virta, you may come in contact with sensitive patient information that is governed by HIPAA. Throughout your career at Virta, you will be expected to follow Virta's security and privacy procedures to ensure our patients' information remains strictly confidential. Security and privacy training will be provided.* *As a remote\-first company, our team is spread across various locations with office hubs in Denver and San Francisco.* *Clinical roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, HI, RI* *Corporate roles:* *We currently* ***do not hire*** *in the following states: AK, DE, HI, ME, MS, OK, SD, VT.* *Virta uses Ashby as its applicant tracking system, which incorporates AI\-powered tools (provided by OpenAI, AWS, and Google Gemini) in certain aspects of the recruiting process, including application review, candidate screening, and interview note taking; your data is not used to train AI models, and all final hiring decisions are made by Virta Health personnel.* **For more information, see Virta’s AI Interview Resources page.** **https://www.virtahealth.com/careers/ai\-interview\-resources**

jobs.title: Lead Safety Technician
jobs.description: WSP is currently initiating a search for a Lead Safety Technician to join our Construction Management team for our Power Constructors, Inc. (PCI) sector for Las Vegas, Nevada office. This position will be a field\-based position that includes working in various field offices across the state of Nevada. Approximately half of the time will be working out of the field office and the other half in the field (i.e. Transmission line, substation, and telecommunications sites). WSP brings global expertise in power delivery, power generation, and program management—anchored by the acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. TRC Companies have now joined WSP, deepening our power practice and expanding our energy advisory and intelligent grid services. We're partnering with clients to shape how energy systems evolve around the world—and we need your help. Be involved in projects with our Power Constructors Inc Team and be a part of a growing organization that meets our clients' objectives and solves their challenges. WSP will not provide sponsorship for this position. **This Opportunity** -------------------- Leads field project safety planning and execution involving large\-scale technically complex electric utility construction projects. This project role supports WSP scope, helps resolve high\-impact field safety issues, promotes alignment with client expectations, monitors contract health and safety requirements, and tracks performance objectives. The individual will leverage expertise in electric utility construction methods, associated regulatory compliance, and defined contract terms to facilitate in\-depth monitoring and reporting requirements. Supports the development of long\-term project safety strategies, promotes innovation in construction practices, and champions risk mitigation efforts that promotes a committed project safety culture. **Your Impact** --------------- * Responsible for leading the overall field execution of WSP’s safety management scope of work for the Greenlink Nevada Program. * Coordinate technical and operational aspects of safety, ensuring alignment with contract scope and regulatory standards. * Serve as the WSP field safety liaison between NV Energy, contractors, consultants, and agency representatives * Oversee the implementation of construction safety strategies and promote a culture of safety excellence. * Participate in executive\-level client briefings, board meetings, and progress reporting forums. * Evaluate contractor safety performance and participate in performance reviews and closeout assessments. * Contribute to innovation initiatives by promoting new tools, technologies, and process improvements. * Communicating known job site hazards to WSP employees, WSP subcontractors, construction contractors, and NV Energy. * Develop, maintain, and execute Project safety management plan and other safety related project execution plan documents. * Develop, maintain, and execute WSP’s Site\-Specific Safety Plan(s) for the Program. * WSP’s Safety Manager will review all contractor(s) SSSPs and work plans to ensure compliance with NV Energy Safety Requirements and all applicable federal, state, and/or local laws/regulations. This includes subcontractors of WSP. * Assists to identify, and provide contact information for, the local medical, fire, and law enforcement agencies closest to the Project site. * Reviewing contract requirements related to safety and health with the construction contractor(s) and their subcontractors’ designated representatives; including, but not limited to, rules and procedures, personal protective equipment (PPE), allowable working hours, and special work permits or specialized work procedures. * Informs WSP’s subcontractors’ designated representatives of the emergency response plan requirements respective to the Project site. * Participates in daily tailboard meetings and other project meetings as required. * Performs thorough periodic/random safety audits, reporting safety discrepancies/deficiencies. Audit results requiring corrective action, training, or other follow\-up will be shared with WSP Management and Company. * Observing and reporting unsafe work activities to WSP Management, and/or NV Energy safety representative on a defined cadence and in accordance with the 1st Application reporting platform. * Facilitates the implementation and processing of the NV Energy 1st Application reporting on the program. This includes, but not limited to field engagement, job observation, safety meeting, and safety incidents, including injury, vehicle damage, equipment damage, inadvertent operation, near miss, hazard identification, good catch, serious injury/fatality exposure and work stoppage. * Reviews construction contractor incident report and root cause analysis. * Processes WSP and NV Energy incident report and root cause analysis. * Maintains records to demonstrate Program compliance on the POWER360 software program and 1st Application. Files related to safety which  alyses (JHAs), Safety Data Sheets (SDSs), Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis. * Ability to foster a culture of safety, not just enforce compliance. * Skilled in developing and delivering safety training programs. * Detail\-oriented and highly organized. * Proactive risk mitigation mindset. * Ability to prepare and present executive\-level progress reports, technical documentation, and briefings. * Ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, clients, and contractors under high\-pressure situations. * Capable of working across offices and geographic regions to support distributed project delivery. * Record of ethical leadership, client stewardship, and operational excellence. * Strong organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with attention to detail. First Aid/CPR Certification. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Associates Degree. * Certified Safety Professional (CSP). Certified Utility Safety Professional (CUSP). * WSP Benefits: WSP provides a comprehensive suite of benefits focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. These benefits include coverage related to medical, dental, vision, disability, and life; retirement savings; paid sick leave; paid vacation (or other personal time); paid parental leave; and paid time off for purposes of bereavement, voting, and/or attendance at naturalization proceedings. Compensation: Expected Salary: $91,100 \- $162,400 WSP USA is providing the compensation range that the company in good faith believes it might pay and offer for this position, based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities in addition to internal equity and specific geographic location. WSP USA reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, and/or federal law. **About WSP**WSP USA is the U.S. operating company of WSP, one of the world's leading engineering and professional services firms. Dedicated to serving local communities, we are engineers, planners, technical experts, strategic advisors and construction management professionals. WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper. www.wsp.com WSP provides a flexible and agile workplace model while meeting client needs. Employees are also afforded a comprehensive suite of benefits including medical, dental, vision, disability, life, and retirement savings focused on providing health and financial stability throughout the employee’s career. At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started? WSP USA (and all of its U.S. companies) is an Equal Opportunity Employer Race/Age/Color/Religion/Sex/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/National Origin/Disability or Protected Veteran Status. The selected candidate must be authorized to work in the United States. **NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:** WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.

jobs.description: **WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US** At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness\-focused real estate. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best\-in\-class team. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Welltower is looking for a Privacy Engineer to help build and scale the technical side of our privacy program. This role will work at the intersection of legal, security, and technology, turning privacy requirements into practical, working controls that protect our data and help the business move faster. This role will design and build the technical solutions, in specified platforms, of privacy compliance to reflect the policies, positions and initiatives we are taking. This role will bridge the gap between legal requirements and technical implementation and will build the tools, tests, and controls that put them into practice. This is a hands\-on role with high visibility and a real opportunity to shape a growing program. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Privacy risk assessments:** Integrate privacy reviews, including privacy impact assessments (PIAs) and privacy threat modeling, into the existing security intake process so that privacy risks are identified early, both for new vendors and for facilities before they are onboarded without duplicating assessments or slowing the business down. * **Incident response:** Work alongside the security team during incidents, assessing privacy impact in parallel with the technical investigation. Analyze impacted PHI and PII to support fast decision\-making and regulatory notification analysis. * **Privacy by design:** Get involved early in the planning of new systems, products, and initiatives. Working with business and technology teams, this role will identify privacy risks and implement privacy\-by\-design patterns and data minimization controls such as collecting only the data that’s needed, limiting who can access it, setting retention rules, and capturing consent where required, so privacy is built in from day one rather than added later. * **Regulatory translation:** Interpret what privacy laws such as UK GDPR, HIPAA, CCPA, and other U.S. state privacy laws require in practice, and turn those requirements into specific technical controls and system settings. Examples include access restrictions, data retention and deletion rules, consent capture, and automated checks that confirm we stay compliant over time. * **Data governance:** Lead and maintain critical initiatives such as data inventories, data mapping, data classification (including distinguishing PHI from PII), and our OneTrust implementation, keeping them current as the business evolves. * **Web consent and marketing privacy controls:** Configure and maintain privacy controls across Welltower's websites and marketing technology. This includes consent and cookie management in OneTrust, tag and pixel governance, honoring browser opt\-out signals such as Global Privacy Control, and making sure consent preferences carry through to analytics, CRM and advertising platforms. Run regular scans and testing to confirm these controls keep working as sites and vendors change, especially on pages where tracking could expose health or other sensitive information. * **Privacy operations:** Handle the day\-to\-day technical work that keeps our privacy program running, including: reviewing vendors’ privacy and data handling practices as part of procurement; monitoring consent preferences and website cookies; tagging and classifying data (for example, identifying PHI versus PII); analyzing the data involved in potential breaches; and building out role\-based access controls (RBAC) so employees can access only the data they need for their roles. * **Privacy automation and technical controls:** Build and automate the technical side of the privacy program using Python or similar program languages. That means connecting data subject request workflows to the systems where data lives, running automated data discovery and classification, and working with Data Engineering and Security to put in place safeguards such as masking, encryption, and retention and deletion jobs. Manage code and configuration in GitHub, build privacy check into CI/CD pipelines, and use Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to apply privacy controls consistently across environments. categorization, geo\-rules and script blocking. * Understanding of marketing and analytics technology (e.g., GA4, Meta Pixel, Conversions API, server\-side tagging) and the privacy risks each one carries. * Ability to explain technical and regulatory concepts clearly to legal, security, and business audiences. * Privacy certification such as CIPT, CIPP/US, or CIPP/E is a plus. *Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, drug screening, and verification of employment, education, and other credentials relevant to the position.* **WHAT WE OFFER** * Professional Growth * And much more! https://welltower.com/newsroom/careers/ (https://welltower.com/newsroom/careers/) **ABOUT WELLTOWER** Welltower® Inc. jobs.title: Vice President, Investor Relations
jobs.description: At **d\-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.** We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. **Role Overview** d\-Matrix is a fast\-growing, venture\-backed AI inference semiconductor company. Our Corsair inference accelerator is built on Memory Centric Compute and paired with JetStream networking and Aviator software. Our next\-generation Raptor platform uses 3D In\-Memory Compute (3DIMC) to stack compute directly on DRAM and break the memory wall in AI inference. As our first VP of Investor Relations, you will build the IR function from the ground up and own how our technology, roadmap, and financial trajectory are explained to existing shareholders, prospective investors, and sell\-side analysts as we prepare for the public markets. You will partner directly with the CEO, CFO, and executive team, and serve as the bridge between our engineers and the investment community. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco or New York, with travel to our Santa Clara HQ and worldwide for investor and PR events as needed. **What You Will Do** * Define and execute a multi\-year IR strategy aligned with corporate strategy, financing milestones, and the path to becoming a public company. * Own the d\-Matrix equity story, including the shift from training to inference, the memory wall, how Memory Centric Compute and 3DIMC compare with GPUs, HBM\-based systems, and custom ASICs, and the Corsair\-to\-Raptor roadmap. * Serve as the primary contact for existing shareholders and for prospective venture, growth, crossover, strategic, sovereign, and public\-market investors, and build the investor pipeline and CRM. * Partner with the CEO, CFO, and Corporate Development on capital raises, including investor outreach, data room management, diligence responses, and coordination with banks and placement agents. * Author investor presentations, shareholder updates, executive scripts, and Q\&A frameworks that translate technical milestones into clear investor messages, and maintain a single source of truth for key metrics and KPIs. * Build relationships with sell\-side analysts and industry researchers, track public comparables and investor sentiment, and brief leadership and the Board on shareholder composition, market feedback, and peer activity. * Build IR infrastructure for a future IPO, including disclosure policy, Regulation FD protocols, quiet period guidelines, earnings scripts, mock earnings cycles, and the IR website, in partnership with Finance, Legal, and outside counsel. * Manage disclosure and confidentiality, align investor messaging with Marketing, Communications, Sales, and Legal, prepare executives for investor meetings and conferences, and hire and manage IR team members and external vendors. **What You Will Bring** * Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 8\+ years of progressive experience in investor relations, equity research, buy\-side investing, investment banking, or corporate and strategic finance, focused on AI hardware, semiconductors, or AI infrastructure software. * Working knowledge of the AI ecosystem, including training vs. inference, GPUs, custom silicon, high bandwidth memory, networking, and hyperscaler spending. * Established relationships with growth, crossover, and public\-market investors, sell\-side analysts, and investment banks. * Working knowledge of Regulation FD, SEC disclosure requirements, and the IPO process and roadshow. * Excellent financial modeling, valuation, writing, and presentation skills. * Experience building a function and team from scratch, with the judgment, independence, and integrity to handle material non\-public information and work across Finance, Technology, and Business. Willingness to travel for investor meetings, conferences, and roadshows. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep technical fluency in AI inference and memory technology, with the ability to explain concepts such as memory bandwidth, energy per token, and 3D stacking credibly to a financial audience. * Strong understanding of semiconductor business models, including fabless economics, gross margin drivers, supply and capacity, backlog, and customer concentration. * Experience in a private financing round or IPO. * MBA or CFA designation. * Proficiency with investor CRM and market data platforms such as Bloomberg, FactSet, or Capital IQ. **Equal Opportunity Employment Policy** **d\-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day. **d\-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d\-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Compensation Range: $230K \- $320K

and test your own work * Understanding of software\-development and application\-security best practices * Ability to read and work within existing codebases * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Ability to clearly explain technical decisions and implementation approaches * Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively * Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities * Availability to work on\-site in the Greater Lexington, Kentucky area **Preferred Experience** Experience in any of the following areas is especially valuable: * React Native * Expo / Expo Application Services * React * TypeScript * PHP / Laravel * Python * Node.js * REST API development * Redux, Zustand, React Context, or other state\-management tools * AWS, Firebase, Supabase, Azure, or other cloud platforms * Mobile authentication and session management * Push notifications and native device features * Apple App Store or Google Play Store deployment * Docker and containerized development * CI/CD workflows * Automated testing * Application modernization or legacy\-system maintenance **AI\-Assisted Development** eLink Design actively uses modern AI development We are looking for developers who can evaluate AI\-generated solutions, identify incorrect or insecure code, troubleshoot independently, explain their technical decisions, and properly test their work. **AI should enhance technical ability—not replace critical thinking, problem solving, or accountability.** *Why Join eLink Design?* * Work on real\-world web, mobile, software, automation, and AI projects * Exposure to a variety of industries and technical challenges * Opportunity to work with modern technologies including React Native, Expo, APIs, cloud services, and AI\-assisted development * Collaborate directly with experienced developers, designers, and project managers * Variety of projects rather than being limited to a single product or technology stack * Opportunities for continued technical growth and increased responsibility * Collaborative environment focused on communication, accountability, and continuous improvement **Application Requirements** Applicants should submit a resume and, when available, examples of previous development work such as GitHub repositories, mobile applications, web applications, professional work, academic projects, or personal projects.
